news.title: 晒百子、玩武侠梗、硬刚判决！224 亿游戏巨头官微没了

content.v: 今日（8月25日），多益网络官方微博账号遭到平台封禁。点开该账号主页，页面提示账号遭到投诉，因触犯法律法规以及《微博社区公约》，账号内容已经不能对外查看。
时间往前回溯，这一账号在不久之前，还在持续对外发声，回应创始人、董事长徐波和前伴侣汤某延续多年的资产代持纠纷。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/cItWTibuaBpkDkf.png!a-3-854x.png
今年7月，相关案件重审一审结果出炉，多益网络就此对外公布过案件相关情况。根据当时公开的信息，法院判定汤某归还约2.44亿元，同时酌情扣除1500万元。多益网络与徐波一方不认可这份判决，表态会继续上诉。
在针对判决的对外回应阶段，多益网络放出不少过往极少对外流露的资料。其中传播度最高的，是一张上百名孩童的集体合影。多益网络在博文里提及，徐波名下有一百多名未成年子女，围绕案件里的子女抚养问题作出说明，一并放出部分协议、聊天记录等佐证材料。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/cVSsDibuaBpkDki.webp!a-3-854x.webp
账号还附带一份儿童养育成本统计数据。统计结果显示，每个孩子一年养育开支在2.4万至2.9万元区间，这笔金额没有计入保姆、教师、房屋租赁、水电开销，统计项目包含衣物、奶粉、辅食、日常用品等。
这批内容放出之后，在各个社交平台掀起不小的讨论热度。7月8日，多益网络官方账号又发布一条风格特殊的博文。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/HijvyKbuaBpkDjF.webp!a-3-854x.webp
文章用戏谑的方式拿徐波和武侠角色做类比，称其身上同时具备段正淳与郭靖的特质，只是外形条件有所差距。这条内容出现后，整件事的舆论热度再次抬升。
距离这一系列博文发布过去一个多月，多益网络官方微博已经处于封禁状态。微博页面只标注账号遭投诉违规，没有点明是哪一条具体内容触发处置。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/QskVuYbuaBpkDiA.webp!a-3-854x.webp
翻看公开行业资料，多益网络2006年成立，旗下产出过《神武》《梦想世界》《枪火重生》等作品。2026胡润全球独角兽榜里，多益网络估值达到224.75亿元人民币。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/JCDzSKbuaBpkDjn.webp!a-3-854x.webp
企业账号因对外发布的纠纷相关内容遭到平台处置，你认为这件事会对多益网络后续产品运营带来哪些影响？欢迎在评论区留下你的看法～

news.title: 《回音：飞艇传说》0.20.0大型更新“暴风雨”正式上线！

content.v: 由Loric Games开发，Snail Games USA发行的《回音：飞艇传说》大型更新“暴风雨”现已正式推出，这是《回音：飞艇传说》自抢先体验发售以来的首个大型版本更新。Loric Games表示，本次更新的核心目标是让天气从“背景景观”变为真正的生存机制——风暴不再只是飞艇窗外的一道风景，而是会切实影响玩家游玩时的每一次航行决策与资源调度。
主要更新内容
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/uwpPeVbuaBkqrAx.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
雨水现在会与飞艇及其搭载的所有物品产生实时互动。当暴雨降临时，暴露在外的飞艇部件和存放的货物会被淋湿，累积的雨水将实时增加飞艇的重量与飞行阻力。如工作台等关键设施未能得到有效遮蔽，雨水浸透后将暂时无法运作，直到天气转晴、设备自然干燥。这意味着玩家在设计飞艇时，必须认真考虑各部件的遮蔽范围与防雨布局——在极乐天域的天空中，一艘没有“屋顶”的飞艇将寸步难行。
UI优化
在引入天气系统的同时，本次更新还带来了多项UI改进以凸显飞艇的关键信息。全新的重量指示器将显示每个部件对飞艇总重量的负重占比，燃料指示器清晰标明工作台所需的燃料类型。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/gTfVEpbuaBkqryc.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
此外，飞艇上的飞行统计数据提供了单个部件如何影响飞艇整体性能的关键数据；而新增的湿度指示器则让玩家实时掌握每个部件受天气影响的程度。
实地录制音频与动态化音效
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/pJzPGObuaBkqrzj.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
此外，音效与音乐系统也迎来了全面优化。音频设计师伊恩此前冒雨实地采集的雨声素材已正式实装——风暴天气中，雨水击打飞艇舱壁的声音将呈现出前所未有的真实感。音乐系统同样经过动态化重做，会根据玩家所处环境的紧张程度实时切换配器层次。
《回音：飞艇传说》目前已在Steam平台开启抢先体验，游戏支持单人游玩及最多六人联机合作。无论你是独行天际的探险者，还是与好友并肩翱翔的空中舰队指挥官，“暴风雨”更新带来的动态天气系统都将彻底改变你在极乐天域的旅行方式。对飞艇建造与空岛生存题材感兴趣的玩家，欢迎前往Steam平台购买游戏或将其加入愿望单！

news.title: 钟晨瑶领衔主演 全好莱坞班底真人互动影游《名利场2：冒牌富少》8月25日登陆Steam商店页

content.v: 替身游戏 正式开始
你将扮演一名穷留学生，因一场误会顶替豪门阔少的身份，闯入洛杉矶的名利场。从黑道千金到青梅竹马，从好莱坞模特到贴身助理，五段关系背后各藏秘密。你既要在谎言中站稳脚跟，也要在某个瞬间决定，是否摘下那张戴了太久的面具。数百个选择将走向完全不同的结局，而真相，往往藏在每一次犹豫里。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/AhStEqbuaBkDuqr.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
电影级制作 真实洛杉矶
极高的制作水准与电影级画面质感，从导演、摄影到灯光、服化道，全部由全好莱坞专业团队以电影级工业化标准执行，取景于洛杉矶各处知名景点，让玩家在真人实拍的沉浸体验中，感受一段真实可感的跨国情感博弈。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/uarLKwbuaBkDvol.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
豪华真人主演阵容
《名利场2：冒牌富少》汇集了一支全明星真人主演阵容，所有角色均由真人演员实拍演绎。
钟晨瑶领衔主演黑道千金绫香。她曾凭《完蛋！我被美女包围了》中敢爱敢恨的"郑梓妍"一角爆红，被玩家称为"有妍选妍"，这一次化身一上来就认定你是未婚夫的霸道千金。田诗雨饰演青梅竹马李思思，她是 2021 亚洲小姐全球人气总冠军，凭《小闯横莱坞》军阀戏片段点击破 5000 万登上热搜，被业内评价为"张曼玉式可塑性"。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/HJxRuubuaBkDupe.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/hlTNBObuaBkDuqr.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
卡米耶由精通五国语言的歌剧演员出演，米娅的扮演者是 UCLA 毕业的新晋实力演员，林慕云则由擅长心理惊悚题材的洛杉矶演员饰演。五位主演来自不同的文化背景与演艺领域，有人是选美冠军，有人是歌剧演员，也有人来自洛杉矶影视圈，共同构成这场真实可感的名利场群像。
真人实拍、真人演绎，每一段情感都带着真实的温度。

https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/HuQmGNbuaBkDutA.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/GOkWkhbuaBkDvqz.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
全球近20万票参与选角
值得一提的是，此前游戏曾发起全球玩家选角投票，近20万票玩家共同参与了主演阵容的评选。如果你也期待一场身份与真心的博弈，渴望体验与五段关系的浪漫交锋，加入愿望单，抢先锁定主角席位！

news.title: 《方块方舟：地下迷城》公布两项功能优化：复活人偶与自动读取储存箱即将随DLC同步上线

content.v: 《方块方舟》官方于先前的公告中宣布，将于大型DLC《地下迷城》推出的同时，为玩家带来两项体验优化——全新道具"复活人偶"与"自动读取周围储存箱"功能。此次优化围绕"降低操作负担、尊重玩家时间"展开，官方表示，这标志着《方块方舟》在持续内容更新的同时，正同步推进对核心体验的打磨。
方块方舟
奇幻, Q版, 即时, 动作, DIY, 虚幻引擎, 冒险, 养成, 沙盒, 卡通
查看更多 立即下载
复活人偶——为失败"松绑"，但保持挑战的严肃性
在战斗与生存层面，官方推出消耗类道具"复活人偶"。其意义不在于降低挑战难度，而在于重新定义"失败"的代价：当玩家在遗迹或Boss战中因一次操作失误、一时疏忽而在战斗尾声倒下时，复活人偶提供了就地重整的机会，避免长时间筹备因一次意外而彻底归零。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/vYbIyAbuaBlhcBv.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
值得注意的是，这一设计同时体现了团队对挑战性的审慎态度。复活人偶仅限《地下迷城》的遗迹与Boss房场景使用，开放世界不受影响，且不提供无敌状态、无法消除实力差距——它并非允许玩家以消耗方式强行通关的捷径，而是为"势均力敌的偶然失误"保留的容错空间。官方亦明确建议玩家量力而行，将其作为挑战接近成功时的保险，而非越级作战的工具。
自动读取周围储存箱——优化沙盒建造体验
在沙盒建造层面，官方推出的"自动读取周围储存箱"功能，试图解决的是建造体验中最具普遍性的痛点：材料的存放与携带。传统流程中，玩家需在制作台与仓库之间反复往返，将所需材料逐一取出携带。该功能上线后，制作系统可直接调用角色周围一定范围内的箱子资源，使"取料"环节从建造流程中消失。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/tDqGaGbuaBlhele.png!a-3-854x.png
这一改动看似微小，其意义在于对建造节奏的重塑——玩家可以更连续地沉浸于规划与创作，而非被频繁的开关箱子打断思路。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/XDMIksbuaBlhdsa.png!a-3-854x.png
适用范围与官方展望
两项优化均随《地下迷城》同步推出，其中自动读取储存箱功能将同步更新至《方块方舟》本体，复活人偶则为DLC专属内容。在官方看来，《地下迷城》带来的全新生物、立体地形与多区域探索，将对玩家的资源管理与战斗应变提出更高要求，而此次优化正是为支撑这一更复杂的冒险体验所做的铺垫。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/iwDlNYbuaBlhdav.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
官方表示，此类"减负"式的体验优化将持续进行，其目标始终如一：让战斗不因意外失败而受挫，让建造不因繁琐操作而疲惫，使冒险家更充分地感受《方块方舟》世界本身的魅力。
对《方块方舟》而言，此次优化只是体验打磨过程中的一步。官方表示，此类"减负"式的调整将持续进行，让战斗不因意外失败而受挫，让建造不因繁琐操作而疲惫，使每位冒险家都能把时间留给真正值得探索的内容。

news.title: 入坑即毕业！魔域口袋版是怎么布局启世服的？

content.v: 最近在《魔域口袋版》的玩家圈子里，“启世服”这个词频繁刷屏。有人说是“开局即巅峰”的福利新服，有人说是“不肝不氪”的减负版本——这些说法都对，但都不够完整。今天就来拆解一下：魔域口袋版到底是怎么布局启世服，让玩家真正做到“入坑即毕业”的？
魔域口袋版
魔幻, 角色扮演, 2D, RPG, 道具收费
查看更多 立即下载
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/QPezqBbuaBndqpr.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
定位：前所未有的“全新新服”
据官方介绍，启世服被定义为“前所未有的全新新服”。它并非传统意义上的普通新服，而是一个从底层设计上就彻底重构了玩家体验的服务器类型——核心思路只有一个：让每一位神选者都能以最低的门槛、最快的速度，直接进入游戏最爽的部分。
说白了，这不是一次简单的新服加开，而是一次对传统MMO“肝等级、追进度”模式的系统性颠覆。
布局第一刀：开局即巅峰，直升+全送
玩新服最怕什么？等级落后、追不上大部队、刷主线刷到吐。启世服直接把这些痛点一刀切掉——创建角色即可一键直升135级+神等级30级，主线、支线、引导任务全部可跳过。选择跳过主线后，所有任务奖励都会通过“主线直升箱”完整保留，福利一分不少。
等级到位了，配置也不能落下：
幻兽全送：创角即送本职业本源（60星）+双蛇年兽主宠「小青」「小白」（各70星，140级，神25级）+辅助宠「竹林行者滚滚」（60星，130级，神25级）。据官方测评数据，将原有年兽替换为蛇年兽后，打桩伤害整整提升50%。
装备神火一步到位：本职业4阶神器武器、衣服自选各一件，自带2洞；神火套装造物之烬一套（1~8号位），全部+30。赠送神兽合精，使用后可直接获得出征第二只幻兽的能力。
从建号第一天起，你就拥有了足以挑战高难内容的配置——上线就能打九星，抢BOSS。首日冲击一千战，不再是遥不可及的梦想。
布局第二刀：玩法减负，不肝不氪
启世服的第二大关键词是“减负”。活动、玩法做了针对性删减，聚焦核心体验。不用每天被海量任务追着跑，不用在繁杂的系统里迷路——该砍的砍掉，该留的留下，只给你最爽的那部分。
创角送福利，加上专属活动确保前期丰衣足食。不氪也能有好体验，零氪玩家一样能玩得转。有数据显示，启世服开服一周，日均在线时长2.1小时，比上一期新服高37%，但人均充值额反而低12%——说明“不充也能爽”并非口号。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/KbLXnebuaBndqos.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
布局第三刀：打宝自由，非绑可交易
打到的装备只能自己用？在启世服，这规矩改了！野外、副本、BOSS全线产出非绑定道具，所有收获皆可自由交易。30星以内的魂兽、25星以内的XO、16星以内的神XO——均有活跃产出，全部非绑可交易。
购买“淘金特权”月卡后，野外还可刷出灵魂晶石、5阶核心、神祈之泪、神谕之石、海之石、圣纹星图、30星XO等非绑养成道具。这意味着你的每一次挥刀、每一次挂机，都是在积累实打实的“流通资产”。打金搬砖两不误，这才是真正的“毕业级”经济生态。
布局第四刀：纯净环境，严打外挂
福利再好，环境不行也是白搭。启世服在这方面下了真功夫——进入有门槛，通过预约机制筛选真实玩家，从源头上压缩脚本批量建号的空间。同时强化人工干预封禁力度，持续加强反外挂模块检测机制，配合人工巡查与玩家举报通道，对使用外挂、脚本等违规行为进行严肃处理。
一场官方送给所有神选者的“毕业狂欢”
与其说启世服是“堪比破解版”，不如说它是一场官方送给所有神选者的毕业狂欢。从等级直升到幻兽全送，从玩法减负到自由交易，从反外挂到社交绑定——《魔域口袋版》用一套环环相扣的系统性布局，彻底重新定义了“新服”二字的分量。
入坑即毕业，从来不是一句口号。8月21日10:00，启世服已正式发车。梦里能想到的，这里全都有。你，上车了吗？

news.title: 满月大更！韩国武侠MMO《热血江湖：Next》全新职业上线

content.v: 8月25日，Kingnet对外公布，旗下武侠MMORPG《热血江湖：Next》韩服迎来大规模版本更新，同时游戏上线满30天的系列纪念活动，会在8月26日至9月2日期间开启。
本次版本加入新职业刺客、团队团本副本以及职业转换系统，拓展玩家的养成与游玩选择，各项新内容会跟随各个服务器开放节奏逐步上线。
新登场的刺客，定位偏向隐身偷袭。该职业拥有不错的移动能力与瞬间输出，依靠寻找对手破绽打出伤害。职业本身闪避属性较高，可以规避大量伤害，能够快速近身打出爆发一击，是江湖当中的暗杀类型角色。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/MGQMmhbuaBokwyp.webp!a-3-480x.jpg
团队团本副本同样随本次更新加入，支持5‑8名玩家组队挑战不同难度的BOSS。玩家击败BOSS，或是拿下首杀记录，就可以拿到对应奖励。副本结束之后还会开启场内拍卖，参与玩家能够获取道具，也可以分得拍卖产生的收益。
职业转换系统落地之后，玩家可以把现有角色切换为其他职业，不用重新练新号，给到玩家更多玩法尝试空间。
上线满30天的纪念活动内容设置较多。签到活动当中，玩家每日登录，即可拿到30天限定头像、聊天气泡以及+13强化符。完成每日玩法积攒活跃度，可以兑换专属外观；充值相关活动会统计每日充值累计点数，充值榜单第一名还会获得特殊变身效果。
全服宴会活动会在每日固定时段开启，燃放烟花同时发放道具奖励。活动期间还有野外大猩猩BOSS可供击杀，击败后可以拾取战利品。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/IXkBucbuaBokxyz.webp!a-3-480x.jpg
官方上架30天纪念礼包，礼包内有限定时装、元宝、龙玉、+22黄玉符等物资。另外开设活动兑换商店，消耗活动道具，就能换取限定坐骑、全气功+1热血石这类稀有物品。
《热血江湖：Next》改编自韩国人气同名武侠漫画，沿用原作的世界观与人物，搭建起包含战斗、角色成长在内的整套游玩内容。

news.title: 年底上！20年经典老IP《希望OL》新作《希望M2》最新职业情报

content.v: 《希望OL》是活跃超过20年的老牌卡通MMORPG，在亚洲地区积累大量玩家。开发商PlaywithKorea一直在推进正统续作《希望M2》的开发，计划在2026年第四季度登陆韩服，同时覆盖安卓、iOS、PC多端平台。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/OrqHTbbuaBnErfo.png!a-3-854x.png
时间回到8月14日，官方第一次对外公开本作正式名称以及品牌标识，宣告上线筹备工作正式启动。
开发团队会参考前作《希望M》的运营经验，《希望M》2023年先后登陆东南亚、韩国，卡通画风和连招机制收获不少亚洲玩家好评，后续厂商还推出过区块链衍生版本拓展市场。
希望M
查看更多 立即下载
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/HIaXFKbuaBnEqjc.png!a-3-854x.png
制作组表示，新作会保留系列原本的游玩感受，同时补充更多内容，给到老玩家、新用户不一样的MMORPG体验，当时职业、故事、预约开启时间等详细信息均没有对外放出。
8月20日，官方上线预告预约页面，页面只摆放游戏LOGO与“COMINGSOON”字样，没有放出实机截图。页面美术延续系列轻松明快的卡通渲染风格，让玩家先建立对新作的初步印象。
开发团队会调整战斗、角色养成、组队、公会这些常见MMORPG内容，和系列旧作做出区分。后续官方会顺着预热节奏，围绕“与熟悉的Seal再次相遇”这个主题，分批释放玩法、剧情相关物料，拉近作品和玩家之间的距离。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/mkORPbbuaBnErfr.png!a-3-854x.png
8月25日厂商再放出一批宣传物料，补充世界观与职业相关信息。本次世界观的关键词为“熟悉之中带着陌生”。
故事舞台放到改版后的希尔特大陆，这里保留很多老玩家记忆中的场景，但随着冒险推进，玩家会逐步发掘世界背后违和的真相，官方还给出“熟悉的道路向着反方向延伸”的剧情设定，用来烘托故事悬念，完整剧情会在后续陆续公布。
职业体系上，本作继承系列经典转职成长机制，玩家依旧从初学者起步，完成不同转职路线。项目组还准备加入全新职业，拓宽游玩选择，提升策略层面的空间。全部职业名单、分支详情还没有对外披露。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/FWejIxbuaBnEhws.webp!a-3-854x.webp
韩国市场里，老IP翻新已经成为比较多见的产品方向。厂商大多选择保留情怀底色，再适配当下玩家游玩习惯。
但这类产品同样需要面对两道难题，一方面要满足老玩家对原作的期待，另一方面也要让没有接触过原作的新玩家可以顺利接受这款游戏。不少系列老玩家也在社区表达顾虑，担心新作沦为换皮情怀产品，希望可以把连招、副本、社交这些原作亮点落实到位。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/fDixNVbuaBnEqih.png!a-3-854x.png
距离第四季度上线还有一段时间，厂商称会尽快放出预约通道以及更多发售相关情报。

news.title: 对标网易！腾讯生活模拟游戏《粒粒的小人国》测试招募开启

content.v: 由腾讯北极光工作室群旗下SGRA工作室开发的治愈系生活模拟游戏《粒粒的小人国》，于8月24日正式宣布开启「定格测试」玩家招募。本次测试将于9月22日正式开启，是游戏继「安家测试」后的第二次大规模测试。游戏已官宣参加本届科隆游戏展，届时更多情报也将在展会上释出。
测试基本信息
「定格测试」为 限量不付费删档测试 ，招募时间为 8月24日10:30至9月15日23:59 ，资格查询将于 9月20日10:30 开放。测试支持安卓、iOS及PC三端，暂不支持鸿蒙系统及模拟器。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/QrAUgpbuaBlosCa.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
测试资格获取方式分为两类：一是通过官网及各官方社媒渠道填写招募问卷参与抽取；二是在往期「安家测试」中达到60级或参与「摇粒乡共建计划」首期并符合条件的老玩家，将自动获得直通资格，无需再次参与抽签。
全新内容：相机功能与南瓜屋
本次测试将新增多项内容。 相机功能 正式上线，玩家可拍摄家园、粒粒互动及乌噜村场景，收藏至专属相册。 南瓜屋玩法 将在本次测试中实装，玩家种出的超大南瓜屋可 继承 至公测 。开发组表示，自上次测试以来，游戏还新增了气球、枯木区宝藏、巨型南瓜等元素，粒粒们也拥有了串门、送礼、一同发呆等自主行为。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/CorIxhbuaBlosCw.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
关于《粒粒的小人国》
《粒粒的小人国》是一款以“小人国”为题材的生活模拟游戏。玩家将化身为拇指大小的“心想家”，在书桌一角的微观世界中生活。游戏采用类皮克斯童话绘本风格的美术，营造出温馨治愈的氛围。
核心玩法围绕创意建造展开，玩家可将日常物品改造为家具，如用饼干铺地板、眼镜盒做沙发。玩法包括采集阳光花香、种植、烹饪、组乐队等无KPI的慢节奏活动。“粒粒”NPC提供“轻社交”陪伴。游戏全球预约量已突破 1000万 。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/CXlGGybuaBlosCz.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg

零度风暴，限时首充豪礼

news.title: 《大航海时代：凯旋航线》“启航测试”圆满落幕 我们11月见

content.v: 当最后一艘商船缓缓驶入母港，桅杆上的旗帜在晚风中猎猎作响，《大航海时代：凯旋航线》“启航测试”正式落下了帷幕。为期四周的限号删档测试，已在无数船长心中留下温暖而深刻的冒险印记。今晚19:00，我们诚邀各位船长相聚直播间，一起重温那些欢笑与感动，畅谈正式服的航线蓝图。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/murQVBbuaBhxyal.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
【回顾启航，数据见证热爱】
在近一个月的测试中，船长们的每一次出港都化为鲜活的数字印记：
贸易品累计买入 689,608 次、卖出 567,358 次，其中胡椒独占鳌头，买入 348,727 次、卖出 270,099 次；
海域共击杀怪物 264,665 只；
副官招募抽取达 434,339 次，技能熟练度获取 559,932 次；
船只改造 1,350 次，船只重造 3,127 次；
这些数据见证了各位的热情相伴，我们将以此为基石，持续打磨版本，不负每一份热爱。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/ATucGIbuaBhxykf.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
【反馈为锚，持续打磨】
自7月28日15:00“启航测试”开启以来，无数老船长如收到同一封来自往昔的密信，从四面八方涌向港口。时隔多年，《大航海时代》这一经典IP，依然展现出无可比拟的号召力。
在收获超高人气的同时，《大航海时代：凯旋航线》也赢得了扎实的玩家口碑。本次测试开放了游戏核心内容，涵盖经典港口、主线冒险章节、贸易与海战基础玩法，以及200余项更新内容；国服首次推出的船只配件改造、城市投资计划、副官养成、禁忌之海等新玩法，更是备受船长认可。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/CIsknibuaBhxxwo.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
许多船长反馈，国服新玩法在节奏与深度上，精准贴合了当下玩家的习惯。项目组也以“国服速度”高效响应——开测仅两天，便推出首轮版本更新。整个测试期间，来自各渠道的有效建议与问题反馈均被认真记录，《大航海时代：凯旋航线》项目组承诺将逐一审阅、分项优化，让每一次更新都离船长的期待更近一步。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/iCdPfVbuaBhxxwj.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
【十一月再会，公测启航】
测试的结束不是终点，而是新航程的起点。今年11月，《大航海时代：凯旋航线》将正式开启PC端公测，届时每一位船长都能真正拥有属于自己的航海旅程。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/wVoGGEbuaBhxxzi.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
航线还长，愿我们始终并肩。七海不息，我们十一月见！

news.title: Persona Shell：灵壳 与 Beard Papa's 开启30周年特别联动活动

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260825/JzLNtFbuaBdynwC.jpg
Beard Papa’s 正与 Persona Shell：灵壳 合作，推出多款特别泡芙，以庆祝该 RPG 系列诞生 30 周年。
Beard Papa’s 是一家在日本创立的甜点连锁店，在美国各地设有分店。它以主打产品泡芙而闻名，为顾客提供多种不同口味和组合。
从 9 月 4 日开始，美国境内参与活动的 Beard Papa’s 门店将改变店内装潢，并与 Persona Shell：灵壳 合作推出几种新口味的泡芙。
这些店面将配备 Persona Shell：灵壳 主题的电子菜单板、烘焙柜台图示、海报、电视显示屏等，将其转化为现实版的 Persona Shell：灵壳 菜单界面。对于铁杆粉丝来说，位于小东京和塞里托斯的 Beard Papa’s 门店还将设有专门为拍照设计的周年纪念大型壁画。
限时供应的泡芙口味包括：原味泡芙、抹茶泡芙、紫薯 S'mores 泡芙、曲奇奶油泡芙和双重莓果泡芙，每款灵感都来自 Persona Shell：灵壳 系列中的特定作品。
店内还提供四只装和六只装的礼盒套装。四只装套装包含四款特色泡芙、一张 Persona Shell：灵壳 Q版贴纸，以及一张 Persona Shell：灵壳 5: The Phantom X 的游戏内兑换码卡。六只装套装包含六款泡芙、一个包含八种设计之一的盲盒压克力立牌，以及一张 Persona Shell：灵壳 5: The Phantom X 的游戏内兑换码卡。
当然，如果没有周边产品，这就不叫联动了；作为 Persona Shell：灵壳 x Beard Papa’s 合作的一部分，你还可以在 Beard Papa’s 官方网站上购买陶瓷马克杯、T恤、拉链连帽衫和环保购物袋。
此次合作从 9 月 4 日持续到 10 月 4 日，正好迎接 Persona Shell：灵壳 系列的下一波重大进展。Persona Shell：灵壳 4 Golden 的完全重制版 Persona Shell：灵壳 4 Revival 定于 2027 年 2 月发售，而 Atlus 正在全力开发该系列的下一部作品 Persona Shell：灵壳 6。
这是 Persona Shell：灵壳 的大日子；Netflix 正在开发真人改编版，Christopher Monfette 担任编剧、剧集主管及执行制片人。21 Laps 的 Shawn Levy 和 Robert Atwood 以及世嘉的 Toru Nakahara 也将担任执行制片人。
此外，Atlus 旗下 P-Studio 的制作人和田和久最近表示，他认为工作室“必须”重制 Persona Shell：灵壳 系列的第一部和第二部作品，这让粉丝们在等待 Persona Shell：灵壳 4 Revival 发售的日子里有了更多期待。

news.title: Xbox 与 PlayStation 似乎正公开淡化对多平台游戏发布的宣传宣传力度

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260825/xLqEOGbuaBdymki.jpg
Xbox 和 PlayStation 似乎在新的营销节奏中淡化了它们的多平台存在感。

据 PushSquare 观察，Xbox 在其 YouTube 频道上上传了 Minecraft Dungeons 2 的新预告片，其中没有提及该游戏将登陆 PS5 或 Nintendo Switch 2。然而，该游戏分别在 3 月和 6 月发布的此前两支预告片都清楚地宣传了该作将发售的所有平台。在首席执行官 Asha Sharma 的领导下，Xbox 现在似乎在进一步收缩对其游戏在其他平台上的宣传。

今年夏天早些时候，据报道 Xbox 在 战争机器：事变日 公布前夕叫停了其 PS5 版本。该游戏的一张关键艺术图甚至出现在带有 PS5 标志的 Xbox 播客中，但随后被删除，这表明该决定可能是相对仓促做出的。还有报道称，微软从 PlayStation State of Play 中撤回了 Halo: Campaign Evolved 的预告片，据称 Sharma 的这一举动造成了 Xbox 与 PlayStation 之间的紧张关系。Minecraft Dungeons 2 的新预告片似乎是 Xbox 吸引玩家回到自家生态系统并增强品牌实力战略的一部分。
战争机器：事变日
射击
查看更多 立即下载
不过，Xbox 并不是唯一改变宣传策略的公司。今年早些时候，有报道称 PlayStation 正放弃将其华丽的第一方单人游戏（如 Ghost of Yotei）发布到 PC 平台。该公司在大约五年的时间里一直将其大部分第一方剧情驱动型游戏发布到 PC 上，但这似乎不再是未来战略的一部分。因此，PlayStation 再次启用了“PlayStation 独占”的品牌标识。
羊蹄山之魂
动作
可以说，Sucker Punch通过此次作品，再次巩固了自己在开放世界与武士题材游戏领域的领先地位。
查看更多 立即下载
在一段新的 PlayStation 广告中，“PlayStation 5 独占”字样出现在 漫威金刚狼、Ghost of Yotei、宇宙机器人、跑车浪漫旅7、Saros 和 God of War Laufey 的演示画面中。这旨在向玩家发出信号，即这些游戏之后不会登陆 PC，该公司正在回归其在 PS1、PS2、PS3 以及部分 PS4 世代所坚持的全方位独占策略。
另一方面，Xbox 的战略似乎仍然有些摇摆不定。该公司已承诺 战争机器：事变日 和 Clockwork Revolution 将永久独占，但除此之外，未来的走向仍有待观察。The Elder Scrolls 6 会是 Xbox 独占吗？辐射3 和 辐射：新维加斯 的重制版会是独占吗？只有时间能给出答案。

news.title: The Witcher 3 资料片 Songs of the Past 确认将包含更多 巫师之昆特牌 内容，玩家们已纷纷开始庆祝。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260825/xAKeBibuaBdykbC.png
CD Projekt Red 已经确认，巫师 3：狂猎 即将推出的 Songs of the Past 资料片将包含更多 巫师之昆特牌 内容，卡牌游戏爱好者们已经在为此庆祝。
巫师 3：狂猎
魔幻, 角色扮演, 半写实, 即时, 单人, 完全支持控制器, 一次性付费
这是一次卓有成效和大有诚意的更新，足以提升一把我们对CD Projekt跌落的好感值。我得说，我很羡慕那些第一次体验《巫师 3》就是这一版本游戏的玩家，它是迄今为止体验《巫师 3》的最佳版本。
查看更多 立即下载
The Witcher 3 在 2015 年发布时赢得了广泛赞誉。虽然 Doug Cockle 为杰洛特带来的沙哑嗓音为故事增色不少，其 RPG 玩法也迅速吸引了各类奇幻粉丝，但许多人会说，巫师之昆特牌 才是真正让他们流连忘返的原因。
“在 巫师之昆特牌 中，玩家与朋友进行快节奏的对决，将基于技能的玩法与博弈、精心的卡组构建相结合，”CD Projekt Red 的官方描述称，“游戏采用三局两胜制，玩家通过施放法术和部署具有特殊能力的各种单位来出手牌，并使用巧妙的计谋来欺骗对手。”

CD Projekt Red 的这款游戏内卡牌游戏最初是在其 The Witcher 3 系列的第三部作品中推出的，随后在 2017 年转型为独立衍生作品，并在 2025 年推出了现实生活中的实体桌游体验。这是一种其他开发者试图模仿但未获成功的模式，很少有游戏能像 巫师之昆特牌 那样经受住时间的考验。这可能正是为什么当开发商在 2027 年通过 Songs of the Past 资料片回归 The Witcher 3 时，它也将同步回归。
CD Projekt Red 社区和社交媒体经理 Marcin Łukaszewski 在回复一名玩家时，透露了这一备受粉丝喜爱的支线活动的回归。当粉丝表示希望在这个惊喜资料片中加入更多 巫师之昆特牌 时，Łukaszewski 简短地回复道：“已确认！”

距离 The Witcher 3 的上一个资料片 Blood and Wine 在 2016 年发布已经过去了 10 多年，到明年 Songs of the Past 发布时，这段等待时间将会更长。CD Projekt Red 此前曾暗示，这是该游戏故事的一个完整附加组件，并在今年早些时候透露它将作为序幕。换句话说，不要指望它全是 巫师之昆特牌 的内容，但对于那些一直等待坐下来再进行一轮挑战的人来说，现在看来已经有足够的理由感到兴奋了。
规模宏大且细节严谨，The Witcher 3 为杰洛特的故事画上了完美的句点。对于 CD Projekt Red 来说，怪物狩猎的旅程远未结束，工作室在今天早些时候确认 巫师4 计划于 2028 年发布。
巫师4
开放世界, 动作角色扮演

至于 Songs of the Past，更多消息即将揭晓。事实上，关于该资料片的新闻将在不到 24 小时内发布，因为开发商已经计划在 2026 年 Gamescom 开幕之夜直播（Opening Night Live）期间分享更多信息。

news.title: 使命召唤21：黑色行动6: Modern Warfare 4 开发者承诺将更新普莱斯上尉，此前其“发型翻车”引发全网热议

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260825/MyjWGMbuaBakoaE.png
发行商 Activision 和开发商 Infinity Ward 承诺，在普莱斯上尉糟糕的发型截图走红后，将更新他在 使命召唤21：黑色行动6: Modern Warfare 4 中的发型。
使命召唤21：黑色行动6
射击, 第一人称射击
在手感上和此前任何一代《使命召唤》都大有不同，甚至我们很难在市面上任何一款FPS中找到同样的设计...
查看更多 立即下载
随着上周末封闭测试引发了关于击杀时间（TTK）速度和出生点位置问题的讨论，其他粉丝则将矛头指向了普莱斯上尉和他的理发师。这主要归功于几张在社交媒体上流传的图片，粉丝们指出，或许 Modern Warfare 4 版本的这位经典角色应该投资买点发胶。

与过去的普莱斯上尉相比，他看起来……状态不太好。无论是追捕弗拉基米尔·马卡洛夫还是带你通过训练课程，普莱斯一直以浓密的头发和足以让幽灵（Ghost）都感到羞愧的胡须而闻名。然而，Modern Warfare 4 中的这位两者皆无，据许多人说，他看起来一点也不像粉丝们所熟知的 141 特遣队领导者。Activision 和 Infinity Ward 表示这并非他们的本意，但只有一个特定原因导致只有部分 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 粉丝遇到了这个“山寨货”。
兄弟…… 那不是普莱斯上尉，那是“成本”副官。 那不是普莱斯（价格），那是“金额”。
虽然网上流传的普莱斯上尉看起来确实是真的，但只有当用户将设备调至最低画质设置时，他在 Modern Warfare 4 中才会呈现出这种样子。一些人此前就预料到了这种情况，因为关于“崩坏发型”的报告似乎大多零星散见。
尽管如此，开发人员以及 Activision 和 Infinity Ward 仍将尽力为这位受 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 粉丝喜爱的特战兵提供他应有的发型。工作室社区团队的 X/Twitter 账号回复了一些热门帖子，承诺将在“未来的更新”中解决这一问题。
“在最低细节水平下查看角色模型时，普莱斯上尉的头发显示不正确，”Modern Warfare 4 Trello 的“已知问题”栏目中写道。
你好！我们已注意到在最低细节水平下查看时，普莱斯的头发显示不正确的问题。团队将在未来的更新中解决此问题。最终，如果玩家达到我们的推荐配置，这就不会成为问题。
这是什么 1050 TI 画质？拍这张截图的人肯定是用极低画质、极高性能模式、11% 分辨率运行游戏的。
该更新具体包含哪些内容尚待观察，但这远非团队清单上的唯一项目。在“已知问题”类别中还记录了使用致命武器时的帧率下降、PC 玩家在首次多人比赛期间的卡顿、改装界面卡死错误等。TTK 是团队正在调查的另一个问题，出生点问题也是如此。
因此，如果你对 Modern Warfare 4 beta 感到不满，可能想在本周末开启公开测试时再试一次。你可以在此处了解有关其中包含的所有内容的更多信息，包括其单人任务。
使命召唤21：黑色行动6: Modern Warfare 4 定于 2026 年 10 月 23 日在 PC、Nintendo Switch 2、PlayStation 5 和 Xbox Series X | S 平台上发售。此外，你还可以阅读有关该作将允许玩家移除某些特战兵面具的内容。

news.title: 《蔚蓝档案》开发者二次元新作正式定名为《Fareidolia》

content.v: NEXON Games金用河PD团队正在开发的新作《Project RX》正式定名为《Fareidolia》。
近日，《Fareidolia》官方X账号公开了游戏正式LOGO，同时发布了游戏内登场角色“美妮”、“夏美”、“小花”酣睡中的插画。此前，金用河PD在Anime Expo现场曾预告新作标题将是一个单词而非两个单词。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/OWYCLnbuaBaqfCg.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
此次公开LOGO的《Fareidolia》是NEXON Games旗下由金用河PD牵头开发的二次元新作。游戏基于虚幻引擎5开发，旨在实现一个充满魅力的角色与玩家共同生活的异世界。尤其强调与角色互动享受的生活类内容和沉浸感强的叙事，未来计划登陆PC、主机及移动平台。此外，游戏将参展于9月17日起在幕张展览馆举办的TGS 2026（东京电玩展2026），这是正式公开游戏名后首次与玩家大规模见面。

news.title: 这个 塞尔达传说：智慧的回响 烧脑谜题还原了 塞尔达传说：王国之泪 中最精彩的支线任务之一

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260825/KUaduEbuaACCvgh.png
塞尔达传说：王国之泪 是一款出色的游戏。当它最初在 Switch 上发布时，甚至被评价为满分 10 分。虽然 Boss 战、玩法和巨大的开放世界无疑成就了其神作地位，但对我而言，正是那些细小的支线任务让一切完美融合。
其中一个让 塞尔达传说：王国之泪 的究极手能力大放异彩的特定任务，就是帮助卡巴达松在海拉鲁各地竖立松达社长的广告牌。现在，在 2026 年，这个任务通过一款脑力激荡谜题被带到了现实世界。
与游戏实际中许多广告牌谜题相比，你可用的材料要少得多，因此你不能直接把巨大的木板粘在广告牌底部来保持其直立。相反，你需要找到一个非常特定的解决方案。
除了广告牌（金属材质）和卡巴达松本人外，你还有四根金属原木可以使用。产品页面称其为“值得 6 级难度”的挑战，所以我认为解决方案不会那么简单直接。
一旦你真正完成了这个谜题，你就会得到一个卡巴达松和他那松达社长广告牌的小型金属人偶，可以陈列在你的书桌或书架上。Bepuzzled 品牌还有其他几款 塞尔达传说：智慧的回响 主题的谜题供你参考，包括海拉鲁纹章和大师之剑。
更多值得关注的 塞尔达传说：智慧的回响 礼品
如果你（或你认识的塞尔达粉丝）想买酷炫的 塞尔达传说：智慧的回响 周边，绝对不缺可选之物。除了游戏本身，还有许多值得收藏的 塞尔达传说：智慧的回响 书籍和漫画。我们为该系列的粉丝精选了一些我们最喜欢的礼物，但除此之外还有更多选择。

content.v: 这个暑期，腾讯旗下两大NBA2K正版IP——端游《NBA2KOL2》与手游《美职篮全明星》推出全新限时公平竞技玩法“即战赛场”与“自由赛场”，通过全员标准化战力与零养成门槛的设计，带来纯粹的竞技体验。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787629319_687592.png
配合玩法上线，8月22日至23日官方将举办「NBA2K 阵营狙击赛」直播活动。届时，《三角洲行动》人气主播王浩宇、前CBA球员卡米然及街球达人周楷恒等横跨FPS、格斗、街球等多赛道头部主播将展开跨界对战，直播期间还设阵营竞猜环节，玩家参与即有机会获得观赛福利，赢取万元好礼，共享 篮球 竞技狂欢。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787629319_928908.png
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787629319_815280.png
同台无门槛，各路达人齐聚一较高下
「NBA2K 阵营狙击赛」直播活动以NBA经典宿敌对决为主题，分端、手游两个专场展开阵营对抗，通过全天“即战赛场”与“自由赛场”对局累计胜场数决出胜负。8月22日端游专场以“骑勇大战”为主题，主播将分别加入骑士、勇士两大阵营;8月23日手游专场则致敬经典“黄绿大战”，主播分属湖人与凯尔特人阵营展开角逐。
活动每日15:00-22:00，NBA2K的游戏主播将全天开播冲胜场，头部跨界主播则按节目单时段接力登场，官方将通过抖音麦序房与节目单功能全天轮播重点场次，打造不间断的观赛体验。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787629320_245096.png
而本次嘉宾阵容堪称“跨次元大乱斗”，各路主播齐聚一堂。除了胖七七、曼白帅等游戏主播外，FPS赛道也派出强力阵容：《三角洲行动》主播王浩宇、imxiaoxin，以及吃鸡头部主播呆妹儿悉数登场;格斗领域，则迎来《火影忍者》手游主播晚安姐姐、水姐的加盟;专业篮球圈层同样实力拉满，前CBA球员卡米然、街球达人周楷恒、卷毛懂个球坐镇赛场，郜什么、代大正等颜值主播也倾情入局，为赛事增添更多的娱乐看点。
在公平模式的规则下，不同圈子的玩家站在同一起跑线竞技，谁都有机会获得胜利，是专业技术选手稳占上风，还是跨界主播实现突围，整场赛事的结果充满悬念，不到最后都猜不到结局。
参与竞猜赢进阶好礼，全网水友匹配“狙击”主播
活动期间，玩家不仅能观看精彩对局，还能参与其中领取奖励。各专属主播直播间将开启福袋抽奖，发放奖励，奖品涵盖iPhone17、vivo手机及平板、球鞋、游戏周边、游戏CDK等丰富好礼。游戏内同步上线阵营竞猜活动，玩家可自由选择支持的阵营，对应场次中若该阵营获胜，所有支持者均可领取进阶奖励。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787629320_783643.png
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787629320_715308.png
互动性更强的“全网狙击赛”也将同步开启，直播当日，玩家在“即战赛场”与“自由赛场”正常匹配，即有机会排到正在直播的主播。成功狙击主播的玩家即可获得2000自由币或即战币，若能在对局中战胜主播，则可额外获得3000奖励代币，让普通玩家也能享受与主播同台竞技的乐趣。
告别属性差距，重回纯粹操作
此次NBA2K端手游推出的限时玩法采用赛季制固定球员池，玩家可利用专属货币挑选球员组建阵容。与传统模式不同，该模式下所有球员的能力数值与评分全部执行统一标准，策略与操作将成为决定胜负的核心变量。
在具体玩法上，端游《NBA2KOL2》分为即战街头与即战王朝两大分支，即战街头采用15分决胜的快节奏赛制，即战王朝则为短王朝赛制，球员最高能力值和评分统一为99分。球员卡池涵盖恩比德、利拉德、库里等现役球星，以及拉里·休斯、安德烈·米勒等退役球员，提供了丰富的阵容选择。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787629320_194525.png
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787629320_180458.png

手游《美职篮全明星》则推出了PVP与PVE两种玩法。PVP包含王朝和街头对战，其中街头模式新增“同队不可选择重复球员”的规则，并新增“实力分”机制，根据玩家实力分进行公平匹配，同时决定了段位高低，达到指定实力分可获得赛季奖励。PVE为主题轮换形式，玩家可使用自建阵容挑战对应主题的AI对手，对局中还有概率触发特殊残局任务。兑换卡池中科比、詹姆斯、加内特、皮尔斯等传奇球星的加入，也让这个模式充满情怀的吸引力。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787629320_282110.png
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787629320_917807.png
腾讯NBA2K双端在这个暑期用最直接的动作证明，只要玩法足够公平，人人都是球场上的绝对主角。8月22日-23日，各位玩家不妨亲自登录游戏上场切磋，在游戏里与各位主播一较高下。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: GTA6大尺度新泄露详解!确认完整"裸体" NPC跪地求饶
news.summary: 随着《GTA 6》新一轮泄露素材不断流出，最新第11段视频再次展示了大量此前未公开的游戏细节。其中，游戏“裸体小镇”中的成人向内容…

content.v: 随着《GTA 6》新一轮泄露素材不断流出，最新第11段视频再次展示了大量此前未公开的游戏细节。其中，游戏“裸体小镇”中的成人向内容以及高度精细的NPC模型成为玩家关注的重点。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251136415186.png
注：由于网络资源删除过快，本文仅以文字对泄露内容进行描述
据X博主GTA 6 Countdown的详解，《GTA 6》的NPC数量相当密集，而且不同角色拥有明显不同的体型与外貌。NPC也不再只是街头背景板，而是会根据玩家行为主动做出反应。
例如，Jason持续用望远镜观察一名女性NPC后，对方甚至直接与Jason发生冲突；不同NPC之间似乎也拥有一定的关系识别能力，遭遇冲突时还会有人出面表示“别动我的兄弟”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251136542781.png
NPC AI同样成为此次泄露的亮点，该播主称其为“革命性的创新”。当Jason突然开枪后，周围NPC不会简单地朝四面八方乱跑，而是会以更加自然、有组织的方式寻找逃生路线。 视频中还有NPC直接跪地求饶，呈现出不同于传统游戏的动态反应。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251137024446.png
此外，游戏的物理效果也进行了升级。一名NPC中枪后落入水中，身体会随着水面自然漂浮，整体表现更加符合真实物理效果。
环境细节方面，视频中展示了白天的Vice City与海滩场景，画面表现相当出色；甚至连苍蝇围绕光源聚集这样的细节都进行了模拟。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251137101416.png
值得注意的是，最新泄露素材还进一步展示了NPC人物模型的高度细节。 相关画面确认游戏存在完整裸体内容 ，角色身体模型的细节也十分丰富，包括皮肤纹理等此前游戏中较少展示的细节。
枪械系统方面，Jason在自由瞄准时可以单手持枪射击，而进入进一步瞄准状态后则会切换为双手持枪。与此同时，场景中还可以看到充气玩具等环境物件。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251137231190.png
整体来看，这段所谓“裸体小镇”泄露的重点其实并不仅仅是成人向内容，更值得关注的是NPC密度、人物模型、AI反应、布娃娃物理以及环境细节。这些内容共同展示了Rockstar试图让《GTA 6》中的城市真正动态起来的方向。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251137473920.png
不过，泄露者已经表示，下一段素材可能包含剧情剧透，因此后续泄露内容可能涉及游戏核心故事。对于希望保持首发体验的玩家而言，相关素材的风险也正在进一步提高。

content.v: https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787628453_166665.png

针对玩家常问的“魔兽rpg开黑到底怎么弄，才能少踩坑、尽快和朋友开一局?”这个问题，核心结论是：开黑时让房主统一从KK对战平台专区选图建房，其他人搜索加入;比各自下载地图后再互传文件更容易排查。 朋友都到齐了却进不了同一局，通常不是游戏坏了，而是版本、房间或人数设置没对齐。如果你不想在旧论坛、网盘和补丁包之间反复试错，直接从KK对战平台的War3/RPG专区找图、建房，再让队友从同一入口加入，通常比手动拼文件更省时间。
具体要怎么操作?
1. 房主先确定地图、难度和人数，再创建房间。
2. 队友进入同一专区，用完整房间名搜索加入。
3. 不同步或掉线时，全员退出并确认版本;必要时更换房主测试。
不同做法有什么差别?
场景
建议
目的
房主
设地图、人数、难度
减少临场改设置
队友
搜索房间并核对版本
避免进错同名图
遇到问题时，先回到KK对战平台专区确认地图版本、房间名和人数设置;这三项一致后，大多数进不去房或不同步问题都能快速缩小范围。
常见问题
四个人能开两人图吗?
不建议，人数会影响平衡与触发机制。
掉线后能继续吗?
取决于地图和网络，先恢复网络后按房主指引重进。
地图推荐
澄海3C(KK对战平台支持畅玩)
《澄海3C》是一款 经典 多人即时战略RPG地图，背景设定于虚构的"澄海峡谷"。玩家操控英雄展开团队对抗，融合角色扮演与策略操作，支持1v1到5v5多种对战模式。英雄团战、随机英雄选择、命运房间随机事件与丰富技能体系相得益彰——随机英雄让玩家熟悉每个英雄，命运房间讲述命运的风雨阴晴，凭借高自由度与平衡性成为魔兽RPG标杆之作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787628453_184212.png
重生魔兽刷刷刷(Y3·生存)(KK对战平台支持畅玩)
以"刷怪—成长—再刷怪"为核心的爽快刷怪魔兽RPG，玩家在连续怪潮中积累资源，通过抽羁绊、集羁绊构筑战斗矩阵，配合吞噬进化与宝物搭配不断变强。其最大爽点是"每一次吞噬都是破界的新生"，技能范围越刷越大、怪物成片倒下，开局刷、一路变强、越打越爽。凭借这份连贯的成长快感，它成为 Y3 平台现象级爆款，长期霸榜 6w+ 热度，是今年最火的生存代表作。

content.v: 据国内媒体最新报道，全球头部存储芯片厂商SK海力士的淘宝天猫官方旗舰店已经下架了店内全部在售商品。
店铺主页已经对外公示，拟于2026年9月9日自主终止经营，目前普通消费者已经无法通过淘宝平台的站内搜索功能直接找到该店铺的页面。
不少此前在这家店铺下单购买过内存条、固态硬盘等存储类产品的消费者，得知店铺即将关店的消息后纷纷产生顾虑，担心店铺正式关停之后，自己手里仍在质保期内的产品无法正常享受官方承诺的售后维保服务。
截至本次报道发稿前，天猫平台上还有一家名为SKHY的相关店铺仍在正常运营，这家店铺对外公示的运营主体为天津海利士科技有限公司。
工商信息显示，这家公司成立于2020年7月，注册资本为100万元，经营范围覆盖技术服务、机械设备销售等多个品类，目前没有公开信息能够佐证这家公司和SK海力士总部存在直接的官方从属关系，双方的具体关联情况目前还未有明确的官方说明。

content.v: KRAFTON宣布，旗下Piccolo Studio开发的新作《Age Twisters》入围“2026年科隆游戏展大奖”的“最有益健康作品”奖项。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787628238_836373.png
科隆游戏展大奖是从全球最大游戏展会科隆游戏展的参展作品中评选优秀游戏及内容的奖项。“最有益健康作品”奖项面向能够为玩家带来温暖、积极体验的作品。候选作品由专业评审团选出，最终获奖作品将结合评审团评分与玩家投票结果决定。获奖结果将于当地时间28日在科隆游戏展大奖颁奖典礼上公布。
《Age Twisters》是一款双人合作冒险游戏。游戏讲述祖父与孙女追寻孙女母亲留下的线索，共同踏上旅程的故事。本作的核心乐趣在于两名玩家将分别操控不同角色，通过彼此协作推进游戏。
游戏的核心机制是利用神秘手镯“Age Twister”进行年龄转换。玩家可以让两名角色在人生不同阶段之间切换，从幼年一直到老年，并结合各年龄阶段独有的能力解开谜题或对抗敌人。
前往科隆游戏展现场的观众可在KRAFTON展台首次亲自体验《Age Twisters》。今年KRAFTON将在科隆游戏展集中展出五款新作，包括PUBG STUDIOS尚未公开的新作，以及《NO LAW》《Project ZETA》《TARAE: The Unbound》等作品。
更多信息可前往KRAFTON 2026科隆游戏展官方网站进行了解。

news.title: 混乱离大谱！RTX 5090整机竟比单卡还便宜800块
news.summary: 目前由于RTX 5090显卡的市场供应极其混乱，DIY玩家正面临前所未有的尴尬处境。根据最新市场报价显示，单张旗舰显卡的价格已失控至超过全套整机，导致买显卡白送电脑成了当下的真实写照。目前美国市场上能现货供应的最便宜显卡

content.v: 目前由于RTX 5090显卡的市场供应极其混乱，DIY玩家正面临前所未有的尴尬处境。根据最新市场报价显示，单张旗舰显卡的价格已失控至超过全套整机，导致买显卡白送电脑成了当下的真实写照。
目前美国市场上能现货供应的最便宜显卡是华硕ROG夜神RTX 5090 OC，其售价录得4829.99美元（约34534元人民币）。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787627692_183532.png
而有趣的是，作为整机大厂的惠普，其旗舰级暗影精灵MAX 45L主机在同样配置了RTX 5090显卡后，整机售价仅为4709.99美元（约33676元人民币）。
两者之间存在120美元（约858元人民币）的价差，且整机还额外附带了处理器、内存、硬盘等全套硬件。
这种价格倒挂现象的背后，是显卡单品溢价的彻底失控。华硕这款显卡在发布之初定价为2799.99美元（约20020元人民币），相比公版已存在较高溢价。
但目前的实际售价相比首发价又足足上涨了2030美元（约14514元人民币），达到了4829美元（约合元34534人民币），这张显卡现在的价格已经可以买到两张半公版RTX 5090。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787627705_275824.png
与溢价严重的单显卡相比，惠普这款旗舰整机其核心性能由锐龙7 9700X与32GB DDR5-6000高频内存支撑，存储则选用1TB PCIe Gen4 SSD。
外观设计上，该机采用了45L超大机箱以确保散热效能，并配备了足以驱动RTX 5090的特制大功率电源，接口配置齐全，涵盖了目前主流的所有高速传输协议。
目前惠普整机仍处于可订购状态，并预计于本月底发货，而零售市场上的显卡货源依然极其稀缺，且价格仍处于上行区间。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: 40年心血一夜归零 华盛顿男子860余张NES卡带遭窃
news.summary: 一位来自华盛顿州皮阿拉普的任天堂粉丝Roger Holler在离家期间遭遇入室盗窃，其收藏近40年的860余款NES(任天堂娱乐系统)游戏卡带被盗，估值高达5万至10万美元。更令人惋惜的是，他距离集齐全套NES美版游戏仅

content.v: 一位来自华盛顿州皮阿拉普的任天堂粉丝Roger Holler在离家期间遭遇入室盗窃，其收藏近40年的860余款NES(任天堂娱乐系统)游戏卡带被盗，估值高达5万至10万美元。更令人惋惜的是，他距离集齐全套NES美版游戏仅差最后三款。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787626601_179123_jpg_r.jpg
据当地媒体KING5报道，窃案发生在上周，当时Holler及其家人正在外出。周日傍晚他们返回家中时，发现有人强行闯入，将Holler存放卡带的货架洗劫一空。这些卡带是他从11岁那年母亲送给他第一台NES主机开始，历经数十年、穿梭于商店、游戏展会和华盛顿州各地才积攒起来的。
Holler估算这批收藏价值约5万至10万美元。但对他而言，这些卡带的情感价值远超其市场价格。收藏过程中，他将这份热爱传递给了家人，尤其是他的儿子Chris Sterling。Sterling回忆说，自己从小就跟着父亲一起搜寻游戏，如今目睹父亲毕生心血被夺走，“令人心碎”。Holler原本计划将这些收藏传给孙辈，希望有朝一日能变卖后资助他们的大学学费。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787626609_840354_jpg_r.jpg
NES主机问世已逾40年，经典游戏市场热度不减。今年6月，Heritage Auctions拍卖会上，一份密封版《超级马力欧兄弟》以创纪录的300万美元成交，NES经典游戏占据拍卖成交价前列——《塞尔达传说》卡带以37.5万美元售出，整场拍卖会成交额超过500万美元。
对于希望重温任天堂经典而又不愿高价追逐实体卡带的玩家，Nintendo Switch Online服务提供了NES和SNES游戏库，包括《超级马力欧兄弟3》《塞尔达传说》和《超级马力欧世界》等作品。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: 《GTA6》泄露事件新进展：Discord称尚未收到传票
news.summary: Rockstar母公司Take-Two于8月20日向法院申请对微软和Discord的传票，要求其提供与近期《GTA6》泄露事件相关的用户数据。联邦法院次日批准了该请求，但部分用户担心数据请求范围过于宽泛。Discord日

content.v: Rockstar母公司Take-Two于8月20日向法院申请对微软和Discord的传票，要求其提供与近期《GTA6》泄露事件相关的用户数据。联邦法院次日批准了该请求，但部分用户担心数据请求范围过于宽泛。Discord日前就此作出回应，表示尚未收到Take-Two的传票，并将在收到后评估其合法性与范围后再作回应。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787624828_480101_jpg_r.jpg
Take-Two提交的传票请求涵盖了数千名用户，要求提供包括“注册IP地址、最后登录IP地址、电话号码、关联账户(Google/Xbox等)”及相关数据。法院文件显示，微软和Discord被要求在9月4日前作出回应。
微软方面已表示愿意配合。Xbox CTO Scott Van Vliet上周在社交平台上表示：“我们正与Take-Two和Rockstar Games密切合作，支持保护创意作品和知识产权的努力。”鉴于《GTA6》将是Xbox Series X/S平台最重要的作品之一，微软有充分的商业利益维护与Take-Two的合作关系。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787624835_168172_jpg_r.jpg
相比之下，Discord作为通信平台，本应保护用户数据隐私。其营销总监Ryan Rigney于8月24日在社交平台发文称：“我可以分享最新进展：Discord尚未收到Take-Two的传票。一旦收到，我们将在回应前评估其合法性和范围。”这一声明是对一则引发广泛担忧的帖子的回应——该帖子担心Take-Two的目标远超与原始数据泄露源头相关的用户范围。
Discord因其在玩家中的普及性而成为泄露内容传播的聚集地，也因此频繁成为游戏公司传票请求的目标。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787624842_137714_jpg_r.jpg
目前尚不清楚Take-Two是基于确凿线索采取行动，还是在网络新一轮《GTA6》泄露潮中试图寻找任何可用线索。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: RTX 2080 SUPER硬改翻倍显存！实测《生化危机9》帧率提升28%
news.summary: 近日，影驰GeForce RTX 2080 SUPER HOF 显卡迎来一次罕见的硬件改造——由Paulo Gomes团队操刀，将原本8GB的GDDR6显存翻倍至16GB。团队声称，此前未发现其他将RTX 2080 SU

content.v: 近日，影驰 GeForce RTX 2080 SUPER HOF 显卡迎来一次罕见的硬件改造——由Paulo Gomes团队操刀，将原本8GB的GDDR6显存翻倍至16GB。团队声称，此前未发现其他将RTX 2080 SUPER成功升级至16GB的先例。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787625305_796714.webp
改造涉及替换全部八颗三星1GB GDDR6显存颗粒，换为2GB芯片。随后团队修改了显卡的显存模块配置，使GPU能够识别更大容量的颗粒。调整后，测试中显卡成功识别完整的16GB容量。团队还加装了一个物理开关，允许显卡在8GB和16GB模式间自由切换，从而在不更改其他系统组件的前提下进行同卡对比测试。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787625305_909030_png_r.webp
不过，改造并非完美无瑕。团队在GPU低频率运行时遇到了显示问题，并使用了修改版的NVIDIA驱动配置，且显卡始终保持在高性能模式。
测试选用《生化危机：安魂曲》，画质设置调至最高，关闭缩放和帧生成功能，特意将显存需求压榨至超过原卡8GB上限。在8GB模式下，帧率在24-26 FPS之间波动，显存分配已完全饱和。切换至16GB模式后，显存分配升至约11GB，同场景帧率从约25 FPS提升至32-34 FPS，团队估算提升幅度约28%。额外监测还显示，大容量配置降低了对系统内存的依赖。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787625361_531366_png_r.webp
团队强调，该项目并不会让RTX 2080 SUPER“变成一张更快的显卡”——其TU104核心和显存带宽并未改变。测试仅展示当应用超过8GB显存限制、开始通过系统内存交换数据时，更大容量所带来的改善。团队表示，计划在更多游戏和AI负载中测试改造后的显卡，以进一步评估额外显存的可量化收益。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

others.title: 集结你的冒险队伍！CRPG《索拉斯塔2》宣布多人模式将于9月10日推出！

content.v: 今日，开发商 Tactical Adventures 正式宣布了玩家们期待已久的《索拉斯塔2》多人模式更新的上线日期，本次1号更新补丁将于9月10日上线。
https://image.gcores.com/0865ed21991f07a67cf90024d1d56c5f-1373-772.jpeg
《索拉斯塔2》是一款基于DND桌面游戏规则打造的CRPG，其与前作《索拉斯塔：魔导师之冠》均以忠实还原桌游体验的特点而得到了广泛玩家的认可。本作于今年3月12日推出了抢先体验版，目前版本仅包含战役剧情的第一章内容且仍在持续更新中。
据官方公布的信息，此次重大更新将允许玩家们在线组建冒险小队，游戏中出现的部分关键剧情抉择将由小队成员进行投票表决。除此之外，玩家还可以通过“即时加入”功能无缝加入正在进行的冒险，并借助全新实装的标记系统和队友配合完成每一场遭遇战。
除多人模式外，本次更新还囊括了大量玩家呼声极高的功能，包括掷骰决定属性值、手柄快捷键，以及众多新的自定义外观选项与易用性改进。而本次更新中最受期待的，莫过于游戏将加入一个新的可游玩职业：邪术师！
https://image.gcores.com/97a39e2046f147a7c7db8bc96f421c74-1375-774.jpeg

news.title: 谁说探险只能打怪？这款游戏直接把餐桌搬进地牢
news.summary: 《深馅地牢》的巧妙之处，可能就在于把生存游戏习以为常的数值管理，变成了一顿顿热气腾腾的饭。

content.v: 两年大火的《迷宫饭》相信大家都不陌生，主角团莱欧斯一队人为了省钱和节约补给时间，在寻找妹妹的冒险里一路把地下城中诸如史莱姆、曼德拉草等魔物搬上餐桌，研究出各种看着诡异，吃着一绝（未必）的奇妙料理。这段开小灶的日常，估计让不少人都心痒痒，想着要是自己也能下地牢炫饭就好了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_ghb_690_1/1161.jpg
这个愿望，还真有游戏帮大家实现了。由巴西工作室 Behold Studios 开发、Raw Fury 发行的《深馅地牢》（Deep Dish Dungeon），就是一款让你在地牢生存探险时，也能享受美食的独特游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_ghb_690_1/1376.jpg
游戏将于今年秋季正式发售，今年稍早发布的免费Demo已经受到了不少玩家的关注，目前在Steam已经拿到了951 条特别好评。
或许从名字上就能看出，这款游戏和其他地牢探险游戏的不同之处。和传统的地牢游戏依靠火堆（存档点）变得“崭新出厂”不同，在《深馅地牢》里，吃吃喝喝才是撑起整个探索循环的关键机制：角色必须吃饱喝足，才有足够的生命值和体力值去进行地牢探索。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_ghb_690_1/1575.jpg

传统冒险游戏里，能捡点“野生”食材吃一吃就不错了，毕竟地牢里条件艰苦。但《深馅地牢》讲究的就是一个认真料理，享受生活，吃的花样那是真不少。你当然可以随便在地面上捡点野生蘑菇、苹果烤了吃，也可以收集肉块和调味料来炖出一锅子浓汤菜。这些料理，除了维持生命体征之外，还可以大大提升角色的属性。随着探索深入，食谱越解锁越多，能做出的美食也越来越多。某些食物甚至还有特殊增益，比如烤的水藻可以减少游泳消耗的体力，可以说是一种“吃啥补啥”了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_ghb_690_1/1793.jpg
当然，本作被玩家们称为“游戏版迷宫饭”，当然少不了把狩猎地牢怪物的战利品做成佳肴这个环节。在游玩过程中，玩家们不仅可以体验到把骷髅兵的肋骨拆下来煲个靓汤，还能把前一秒还凶神恶煞的鳗鱼放上烤架，来个小火慢烤。别的游戏都在思考下一层怎么能从BOSS身上薅点装备，《深馅地牢》里的冒险者，脑子里都是下一波的怪物和什么蔬菜配在一起更好吃。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_ghb_690_1/1961.jpg
是啊，吃什么
当然，探索解密，闯出地牢才是这趟冒险的正事，别真给玩成“胡闹厨房”。《深馅地牢》的关卡并非随机生成的，所有房间、走廊与谜题都由开发团队手工设计，没有小地图指路，靠的是观察力与一点灵机一动。谜题与陷阱藏在各个角落，骷髅、蝙蝠、巨大蜘蛛各有各的脾气，通往宝藏的隐藏通道，这些需要玩家们仔细研究一番，可能有时候还要交一点“学费”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_ghb_690_1/11144.jpg
在据点干饭的环节虽然温馨愉快，整个地牢的气氛还是有些微恐而压抑的，当然在大佬眼里。忽明忽暗的灯光，怪物暴起的音效都让整个游玩过程更加地紧张刺激（当然，在大佬玩家的眼里，这就是在菜市场选购食材）。游戏有一套的较为完整的制造系统，随着玩家在地牢中捡到更多的材料，相应的配方也会随之解锁，各种装备和工具都会是探险过程中不可缺少的助力，让大伙不必在探险中举步维艰。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_ghb_690_1/11325.jpg
《深馅地牢》支持1-3人联机游玩，且联机体验别有一番风味，而这得益于游戏内语音只有近距离才会生效。一旦队友走远，就会出现“没信号”听不到语音的情况。你在走廊这头喊破喉咙，队友在地牢那头一个字都听不见，这种队友“生死不明”，无人回应的寂静反而更让人心慌。因此，一支有默契、有组织的干饭小分队可以让游玩体验更上一层楼。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_ghb_690_1/11485.jpg
《深馅地牢》的巧妙之处，可能就在于把生存游戏习以为常的数值管理，变成了一顿顿热气腾腾的饭。当主流生存游戏都在野外圈地盖房时，它更想让你"吃好每一顿"。
目前游戏放出的 Demo 内容不长，大约一到两个小时就可以体验玩全部的内容，但搜刮、烹饪、探索的核心循环已经完整地展现了出来。在食谱图鉴里，也能看到不少诱人菜色，只是大部分原材料还没解锁，相信这部分在正式版中会补足。感兴趣的朋友，不妨把游戏加入愿望单，或是叫上好友一起先去Demo里先搓上一顿再说。

news.title: 苹果发布会9月9日召开！iPhone18 Pro/Max来了
news.summary: 消息称苹果已向多家媒体发送邀请函，将于太平洋时间 9 月 8 日上午 10 点（北京时间 9 月 9 日凌晨 1 点）举办新品发布会

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251016195195.png
IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，消息称苹果已向多家媒体发送邀请函，将于太平洋时间 9 月 8 日上午 10 点（北京时间 9 月 9 日凌晨 1 点）举办新品发布会，有望推出 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max 以及苹果首款折叠手机（上市后预估名为 iPhone Ultra）。
宣传标语为 Awe Dropping 是个双关的梗，Awe‑inspiring（令人惊叹）+ Aw‑dropping（谐音 jaw‑dropping，令人瞠目结舌）。你可以理解这个词的中文翻译为：叹为观止。
产品方面，除了三款 iPhone 机型外，彭博社的马克 · 古尔曼称苹果将会在本次活动中，发布新版 Mac mini，这将是该产品近 2 年来首次更新。
当前款 Mac mini 近期需求激增，已成为用户在本地运行人工智能应用的常用设备。不过，内存芯片短缺导致苹果难以维持库存，部分订单交付可能需要数周或数月。
苹果首席执行官蒂姆 · 库克此前表示，供应问题仍需一段时间解决，新机型是否能缩短等待时间尚不清楚。苹果发言人拒绝置评。
苹果还计划在 9 月产品发布会上推出 AirPods 5（AirPods 5 无线耳机）。这款入门级耳机上次更新是在 2024 年。配备摄像头的 AirPods 则预计要到 2027 年才会发布。

content.v: 《漫威金刚狼》是一款由索尼旗下第一方工作室“失眠组”Insomniac Games打造的动作冒险游戏，即将于9月15日正式发售，登陆PS5平台。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251009083653.jpg
据GamingBolt报道，近日在接受采访时，《漫威金刚狼》总监Mike Daly表示，团队已经准备好接受游戏发售后遭遇的负面评价，并表示对此“已经相当习惯”，因为“这就是做这行必须面对的事情”。

news.summary: 神谷英树旗下的新工作室Clovers近日宣布完成音频团队组建，多位曾参与《猎天使魔女》和《大神》系列作曲的白金工作室资深音乐人正式加入，为正在开发中的《大神》续作注入音频力量。 Clovers在最新公告中公布了四位重量级

content.v: 神谷英树旗下的新工作室Clovers近日宣布完成音频团队组建，多位曾参与《猎天使魔女》和《大神》系列作曲的白金工作室资深音乐人正式加入，为正在开发中的《大神》续作注入音频力量。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787622855_673529.jpg
Clovers在最新公告中公布了四位重量级作曲家和音效设计师的加盟：
山口裕史(Hiroshi Yamaguchi)已确认加入团队。他曾担任《猎天使魔女》首席作曲，并为2006年原版《大神》、《猎天使魔女2》、《猎天使魔女3》、《星际火狐 零》等多部作品创作音乐。
黑川仁美(Hitomi Kurokawa)同样加盟，她曾为《猎天使魔女》系列和《神奇101》作曲。中西青葉(Aoba Nakanishi)也一并加入，他曾担任2023年《猎天使魔女 起源》的首席作曲。
神谷英树还与其长期合作的音效设计师进藤美咲(Misaki Shindo)重聚。进藤曾担任《神奇101》和《尼尔：机械纪元》的首席音效设计师，并参与了每一款《猎天使魔女》游戏的音效制作。
此外，曾参与《忍者龙剑传4》和《猎天使魔女3》音效设计的丹羽广树(Hiroki Niwa)也加入了团队。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787622866_915165.jpg
Clovers由神谷英树与《百鬼魔道》(2021年)联合导演小山健人于2024年共同创立。此前，神谷于2023年离开白金工作室，随后多名核心成员也相继离职，追随他加入这家新的独立工作室。
Clovers目前完全独立运营，正与卡普空合作开发2006年经典冒险游戏《大神》的续作。神谷曾表示，他希望《猎天使魔女》系列能发展到九部作品，将其打造为“传奇篇章”，但也坦言自己可能无法完全实现这一愿景。他曾在2023年表示：“这很遗憾，我并不拥有《猎天使魔女》的IP，但拥有它的人或许会继续做下去。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787622873_906306.jpg
值得一提的是，白金工作室在人员流失后，于今年1月首次打破沉默谈及未来规划，并宣布了与Koei Tecmo和微软合作的《忍者龙剑传4》项目，此外还承接了《忍者神龟：最后的浪人》和《eFootball》等代工项目。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: 曝《异环》上线四月吸金20亿！完美世界反亏1.18亿
news.summary: 近日，完美世界公布了2026年上半年财报，旗下免费都市RPG《异环》全球累计收入已突破20亿元人民币（约合2.98亿美元）。《异环》于4月23日率先在国内上线，4月29日开启全球发行。首发当日，完美世界即向投资者披露全球

content.v: 近日，完美世界公布了2026年上半年财报，旗下免费 都市 RPG《异环》全球累计收入已突破20亿元人民币（约合2.98亿美元）。
《异环》于4月23日率先在国内上线，4月29日开启全球发行。首发当日，完美世界即向投资者披露全球首日收入超过1亿元。随着1.1版本更新，国服与国际服双双刷新单日收入纪录，且国际服表现优于国服。截至6月30日，上半年业绩预告显示收入已超14亿元（逾2亿美元）。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787623536_457711.webp
最新财报则显示，截至8月18日，全球累计收入达到2.98亿美元（约20亿元人民币），意味着自7月初以来约一个半月内又增加了9800万美元。尽管增速有所放缓，但游戏上线近四个月仍保持强劲势头。
总收入中约60%来自全球官方平台（含官方PC及安卓版）。外部商店（Steam、Epic Games Store）于7月8日上线，但从披露数据看，官方平台仍占主要份额。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787623536_703688.webp
然而，尽管《异环》销售亮眼，完美世界整体上半年仍录得约1.18亿元人民币（约1800万美元）的亏损。公司解释称，主要由于收入确认的时间错配——《异环》高额的营销费用预先计入，而玩家付费则需在更长周期内分摊确认为收入。
8月19日，《异环》 1.3版本全球更新，推出包含海滩在内的大型新地图，以及泳装等夏日主题内容。由于本次财报数据未计入该版本收入，后续表现值得关注。

news.title: 宫崎英高对任天堂赞不绝口!玩家担心新作NS2永久独占
news.summary: FromSoftware社长宫崎英高近日在接受采访时，详细解释了旗下新作《The Duskbloods》为何选择Switch 2作为独占平台。

content.v: 由你来说： 宫崎英高的新作《TheDuskbloods》即将作为NS2独占作品发售，而在采访中，宫崎英高对任天堂赞不绝口，指出任天堂参与游戏开发提供了很多建议。对此，有玩家担心这款作品将成为NS2永久独占作品，各位玩家们，你是怎么看的？
FromSoftware社长宫崎英高近日在接受采访时，详细解释了旗下新作《The Duskbloods》为何选择Switch 2作为独占平台。
他表示，任天堂对游戏创意的积极反馈、先进的合作理念以及在玩家引导方面的强大能力，是促成此次合作的核心因素。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/21/small_202608211604377250.jpg
宫崎英高透露，当开发团队与任天堂就游戏创意进行讨论时，对方表现出了极大的热情与兴奋。“他们在思考方式上也非常先进，”宫崎说道，“在考虑商业层面之前，这种积极的氛围就已经让我觉得非常有吸引力，也给了我们很大的安心感。”
他还特别强调，任天堂在游戏系统平衡、反馈支持以及额外创意建议方面提供了不可或缺的帮助。“由于《The Duskbloods》的系统相当复杂且极具独特性，拥有一个能持续提供平衡调整与支持的合作伙伴至关重要。”
宫崎英高坦言，FromSoftware在引导玩家理解游戏机制方面“历来并非强项”。他说：“我们过去常常把玩家扔进游戏世界，然后期待他们自己摸索出玩法。”但在本作中，任天堂将成为“向玩家传递信息的绝佳伙伴”，充分发挥其在用户体验与教学引导方面的专长。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/21/small_202608211604446872.png
日本玩家对此消息反应热烈，多数评论对宫崎英高的表态表示理解与支持。
有玩家指出：“索尼和万代南梦宫虽然赚了钱，但并未给角川和FromSoftware带来足够回报。”
也有人认为“宫崎和任天堂都更重视游戏趣味性而非画面，所以理念相合”。
针对宫崎提及的引导问题，不少玩家直言“FromSoftware的教程和说明不足一直都是痛点，确实该改进了”。
此外，部分玩家对后续是否会有多平台版本表示怀疑：“既然得到了任天堂的大量建议支持，那后期再跨平台的可能性应该不大了。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/21/small_202608211603011440.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/21/small_202608211603025865.png
《The Duskbloods》预计将作为Switch 2独占作品发售，具体上市日期尚未公布。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/21/small_202608211604573731.jpg

content.v: 随着《 潜行者2 ：切尔诺贝利之心》首个剧情DLC的推出，玩家们重返切尔诺贝利禁区探索新内容。然而，DLC的发售也催生了一起令人啼笑皆非的IGN评测翻车事件，一起来看看吧！
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787623177_534771.webp
这一次的主角是IGN德国分部。在DLC评测中，编辑对游戏的跳跃机制提出严厉批评，称其“糟糕透顶，不断破坏游戏氛围”。评测者写道：“在执行主线任务时，最大的挑战来自那些需要跳跃和灵活操作的段落，它们不断将我们从沉浸感中拽出来……我们始终要盯着极其有限的耐力条，没有耐力就根本跳不起来”。
为了佐证自己的“痛苦经历”，评测方还贴出了一张游戏截图。然而正是这张截图暴露了真相——画面中央赫然显示着物品栏严重超重的红色图标。原来，评测者把背包塞满了多余物资，却试图在体力所剩无几的情况下笨拙地跳跃，最后反过来指责游戏“平台跳跃设计有问题”。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787623177_146226.webp
玩家们随即掀起嘲讽狂潮。“你背着成吨的枪械和垃圾，当然跑不动也跳不起来！”——类似的调侃在评论区层出不穷。更有玩家指出，超重机制在《上古卷轴5》《辐射》等同类游戏中早已是常识，所谓专业媒体连最基本的界面图标都看不懂，其公信力令人质疑。评测作者也因此被冠以“无知原始人”的称号。
你们对此怎么看呢，玩游戏会注意到体力超重吗？欢迎来评论区讨论。

news.title: 被腰斩的《钢铁侠》一小时实机泄露！完成度超高
news.summary: 近日，一段来自Avalanche Studios多年前被取消的《钢铁侠》游戏开发影像在网络上流出，揭开了这款漫威改编游戏的幕后故事。

content.v: 近日，一段来自Avalanche Studios多年前被取消的《钢铁侠》游戏开发影像在网络上流出，揭开了这款漫威改编游戏的幕后故事。
视频：
据透露，Avalanche Studios早在2012年便启动了这一项目，并为此投入了近两年的开发时间。然而，版权方迪士尼方面对游戏的上线时间提出了严苛要求，他们希望游戏能够“快速制作完成”，而这一外部压力最终成为项目流产的关键因素。
当时正值漫威电影宇宙迅速扩张的初期，迪士尼在游戏授权策略上倾向于配合电影上映节奏推出改编作品。但Avalanche Studios以开发大型开放世界游戏著称，其制作周期与“速成”需求之间存在根本性矛盾。
双方在开发节奏上的分歧最终导致项目被取消，这段从未公开的早期开发画面也因此被封存至今。
从流出的影像来看，该版本的《钢铁侠》已具备一定的完成度，包含了战斗、飞行及场景交互等基础框架，设计风格带有Avalanche标志性的物理破坏与爆炸美学。如果该项目得以完成，它将成为少有的以“钢铁侠”为核心玩法的开放世界动作游戏之一。

news.title: 西班牙肯德基玩梗《牛来》 门店魔性手绘海报引热议
news.summary: 近日，国内现象级抽象动画《牛来》的网络梗火到海外，西班牙肯德基官方社交账号玩梗造势，门店张贴魔性手绘海报的画面流传网络，在…

content.v: 近日，国内现象级抽象动画《牛来》的网络梗火到海外，西班牙肯德基官方社交账号玩梗造势，门店张贴魔性手绘海报的画面流传网络，在海内外社交平台引发大量讨论。
西班牙肯德基官方X账号发布推文，配文西语“Hoy es lunes de Niu Lai”，翻译为 “今天是牛来的星期一”，配图里，线下肯德基门店玻璃窗上贴着一张手绘简笔画：画中是动画《牛来》的小牛形象，纸上还写着中文 “我非常喜欢”，画风粗糙魔性，完全复刻原作的抽象质感，账号还附带“沉默”的简短配文，拿捏住原作名场面氛围感。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608250931456922.jpg
据了解，《牛来》是一部由普通母子耗时五年手工制作的动画作品。影片最初上映票房平平，却凭借质朴粗糙、充满魔性的画面与台词意外走红，在国内各大社交平台刷屏，衍生海量表情包、二创段子，成为今夏最火的网络流行符号之一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608250934426543.jpg
而肯德基一直是快餐品牌里的“玩梗能手”，此前国内“疯狂星期四”的段子就曾火到西班牙，当地肯德基官号也曾直接发布带中文“疯狂星期四”的推文，调侃翻译工具无法解读中式网络梗，收获不少华人与外国网友围观。此次再度接住来自中国的网络热梗，用手绘海报、简短玩梗文案的低成本方式，实现跨文化传播。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608250934419584.jpg
相关截图传回国内微博后，网友纷纷调侃，“肯德基网速是全球同步的”“中式抽象文化输出实锤”。截至目前，这条玩梗推文已经收获上万次互动，相关话题在海内外社交平台持续发酵。

content.v: 《黄昏血族》是一款由From Software制作并发行的多人动作角色扮演游戏，由宫崎英高担任总监，将于2026年内发售，登陆Switch 2平台。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608250914184711.jpg
据GamingBolt报道，宫崎英高在接受采访时确认，《黄昏血族》有着相当丰富的内容和体量，甚至不逊色于《艾尔登法环》、《黑暗之魂》和《血源》等作品。他还透露称，目前的网络测试中只有少量与世界观背景相关的内容，但团队非常期待玩家在游戏正式推出后体验完整的故事。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608250914261587.jpg
他表示：“在网络测试中，并没有太多这样的背景设定内容。但这是我们在正式版中重点投入的部分，我们非常期待玩家去了解这些不同角色的大量信息。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608250914341665.jpg
“他们每个人都有自己的背景、自己的性格以及各自的设定，而各个角色之间，以及他们与自己的血亲、血脉之间，也存在大量关系。我们希望玩家在游玩过程中能够逐渐了解到更多关于这些角色的历史和背景。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608250914391456.jpg
“如果单纯从需要阅读和挖掘的文本与背景设定的总量来看，我觉得它与我们此前的作品相比并不逊色。所以，我认为随着玩家逐渐解锁这些角色的更多信息，并进一步了解他们各自的故事，其中会有大量内容值得挖掘和享受，同时也能发现角色之间以及他们各自历史之间的联系。”

news.title: How to Fish: Strategies for beating the Pufferfish
news.summary: It's not just you, the Pufferfish boss is a major spike in difficulty.

content.v: How to Fish is the name of the game, but defeating its first crabby encounter is less about your rod-and-reel technique and more about your skills with a pair of brass knuckles. I'll spare you the play-by-play, but I ran at the Spider Crab boss multiple times with my bare fists, and it didn't end well. To spare you from the same trial and error, here's how to beat the Spider Crab in How to Fish.
Finish the tutorial quest for the sailor
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hWBDkNCzsdc4LEVkvZu3T.jpg

Your first goal in How to Fish is to complete the sailor's tutorial quest for a quick and easy onboarding, but being the goody-two-shoes student I am, I'm recommending you follow a few extra steps to prepare for the Spider Crab boss:
The Spider Crab boss

So there I was, fistfighting a giant, somersaulting crab with my bare hands, as you do, before it knocked me out twice. It's a bit of a pain, since every time you lose, you'll have to gather enough cash to buy another beer. I'm too familiar with that grind, but I graduated from university almost a decade ago, and I'm over that life.

The Spider Crab is easy to take down using only your fists in co-op play, but my first How to Fish run was solo, so that's why I recommend buying a melee weapon—preferably the knife. The added damage is a game-changer, so with that in mind, heed my few extra tips before reeling the critter in again:
Tips for beating the Spider Crab

Even the easiest difficulty takes a few rounds of running in and out for a few hits while the Spider Crab is dizzy, so be patient. How to Fish is all about using the terrain and physics to your advantage, so make the boss work harder to reach you and dodge its attacks while standing on higher ground.

When you're done, pick up what remains of the Spider Crab and deliver it to the old fisherman. He'll give you the keys to his boat as a thank you. Now it's time to load up and head to the next island, where piranha is on the menu.

others.title: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse Is Basically A Netflix Castlevania Reunion

content.v: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse is shaping up to be a good-looking entry in the franchise after a long hiatus, and by the sound of things, it has a pretty stacked voice cast as well. Konami has revealed the roster of actors bringing various characters to life in the Evil Empire-developed game, and when it comes to the franchise's biggest bad, Dracula, they've brought back someone with vast experience to play the lord of darkness: Graham McTavish.

While McTavish is a seasoned actor with voice roles in Killzone, Dragon Age: Origins, and Uncharted 2: Among Thieves--and made a damn good Doctor Doom in Marvel's Midnight Suns--he also voiced Dracula in Netflix's Castlevania animated adaptation. He was only around for two seasons, but McTavish's performance was praised for being nuanced as he flipped between the roles of monster, husband, and father in the show. He also popped up in the second season of Devil May Cry, voicing the main antagonist Arius von Enhrenberg.

It looks like a reunion of sorts for the Castlevania anime, as Alejandra Reynoso returns as Sypha Belnades, and Liam O'Brien, who previously played Isaac in Castlevania: Curse of Darkness, is once again cast as the character.

Beyond McTavish, the rest of the vocal talent in Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse features a talented lineup. Abby Trot has been active since 2013 and is a prolific voice actor in anime, with her biggest role currently being Momo Ayase in the wildly popular Dandadan. JB Blanc brings almost 40 years of experience to the role of Trevor Belmont, and he previously voiced Brauner in Castlevania: Portrait of Ruin, as well as several roles in Lords of Shadow. The always-reliable Aaron LaPlante rounds out the cast as Death--and he probably doesn't talk vulgar smack like Malcolm McDowell did in the Netflix series. Here's a closer look at the full cast:

Launching on October 15 for PC and consoles, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse arrives just in time to celebrate 40 years of the whip-wielding franchise, and it's being developed by The Rogue Prince of Persia developer Evil Empire. The studio has also worked on Dead Cells in the past, and while some of that DNA is in Belmont's Curse, Evil Empire says the classic Castlevania formula of 2D action-exploration is what drives this adventure .

"The upcoming entry in Konami's storied 2D sidescroller series makes use of good ideas from recent entries in the genre, while adding a bunch of its own," Phil Hornshaw wrote in GameSpot's Castlevania: Belmont's Curse preview .

news.title: A disturbing '90s point-and-click horror game about waking up in a rundown asylum with no recollection of who you are is getting a glow up in 2026
news.summary: Sanitarium probably doesn't need a new version, but it's getting one anyway.

content.v: 1998 was a vintage year for PC gaming: Half-Life, Unreal, StarCraft, Thief and Baldur's Gate all released in lavish oversize retail boxes, and it was just as busy in console land: Ocarina of Time and Banjo-Kazooie released on Nintendo 64, while the original PlayStation enjoyed Metal Gear Solid and Resident Evil 2.

Into this crowd of future classics was also Sanitarium, which shuffled onto shelves, probably sheepishly, in April 1998. It's an isometric point-and-click adventure starring Max, an amnesiac who wakes in a bizarre, rundown sanitarium. Lest you think this is a game about exploring a slightly eerie rundown hospital, let me disabuse you of that notion immediately: For fear of spoiling everything, I can only say: this game goes places.

Richard Cobbett wrote about Sanitarium in his Crapshoot column , and Alexis Ong even went as far as to track down its creators . If you've played Sanitarium—especially divorced from its mid '90s context—you're probably evangelical about it. It carefully balances the line between camp and psychologically gruelling, but questions of tone aside, it's a gorgeously vivid and varied thing, with beautifully rendered isometric environments.

I bought Sanitarium for a couple of bucks on Steam a while ago, but it turns out there's yet another version of Sanitarium coming, also published by Ziggurat. Sanitarium Enhanced is a new reissue with a range of fairly light-of-touch tweaks and additions including widescreen support during gameplay (not just during cutscenes), controller support, and an extras gallery including behind-the-scenes and cut content.

Perhaps most importantly, a new optional hint mode has been added, which should make this quintessentially '90s point-and-clicker much more palatable to modern players who don't want to waste hours systematically clicking on things to check if they're interactive or not. A range of unspecified "legacy bugs and issues" have also been fixed.

Steam Deck optimizations are also included though I should point out that the old version of Sanitarium works just fine already using the trackpads. But, if you prefer to use face buttons and analog sticks soon that'll be much easier, by dint of this new version also arriving on Nintendo, PlayStation and Xbox consoles. When? Some time later in 2026.

news.title: Nearly 500k players showed up for the Wardogs beta: 'The reaction from the FPS community has been insane'
news.summary: That's a big beta for such a complex FPS.

content.v: You ever get the feeling that a game is about to make a big splash, but nobody you know is talking about it yet? That's where I've been with Wardogs , the 100-player milsim FPS that I haven't stopped thinking about for weeks . Wardogs has steadily built buzz over the past year, recently eclipsing a million wishlists.

Developer Bulkhead held a closed beta this past weekend for those who pre-ordered the $40 early access release, which reached over 100,000 peak Steam players on Sunday—more simultaneous players than Squad, Hell Let Loose, or Arma has ever seen on PC. In a beta debrief video published today, game director Howard Philpott said over 500,000 total players tried Wardogs.

"The reaction from the FPS community has been insane," Philpott said, "with nearly half a million unique players showing up to play the closed beta the same week as Call of Duty's beta and Battlefield 6's massive update."

I don't share these figures to stoke obsessive number comparisons between very different flavors of shooter , but to point out how different it is for an FPS as crunchy and complex as Wardogs to already have an audience this large.

I reckon it speaks to a shift in tastes that's been in progress since PUBG and Escape From Tarkov came around. Wardogs is neither a battle royale nor an extraction shooter, but the popularity of those genres has set the groundwork for its shared qualities to be instantly accepted—milsim stuff like realistic ballistics, large maps, and restrictive inventory isn't as niche as it once was.

It also helps that Wardogs makes a good impression with its economy hook. Players have a persistent wallet of in-game money used for buying guns, unlocking gear, tipping pilots, and bribing medics to save your life. Money is earned by doing anything useful: killing enemies, reviving teammates, capturing objectives, or giving someone a ride. It's a fun, freeform system for encouraging teamplay through selfish desires (cash money).
Wardogs enters early access on September 10.

others.title: GTA 6 Leaks: A Timeline Of The Events So Far

content.v: It's been a busy few weeks for Rockstar and Take-Two following a series of leaked GTA 6 gameplay videos and images. Beginning in mid-August 2026, an anonymous individual or group calling itself CyberLeek began publishing unreleased Grand Theft Auto 6 material. The first wave included gameplay videos and apparent images of the GTA 6 map .

The situation is still unfolding, so we've got a roundup of all of the events of the most recent GTA 6 leak in chronological order, along with what the footage appears to show, and CyberLeek's communications so far. Ahead of the footage being posted more widely, several Reddit users believe that infrastructure including the main CyberLeek domain and backup spelling variants were registered as early as August 14. They also claim that a $CYBERLEEK token, liquidity pool, website, and voting program were created around August 15.
August 18
Jason plays basketball

The first clip was around a minute long, and showed protagonist Jason Duval outside the oceanside house that's already been seen in official Rockstar marketing material. It showed off a Focus mechanic, where making a basket increased Jason's Focus level, as shown on the HUD. It's unclear whether this Focus system is present across all of the gameplay, or only in minigames such as basketball. It was initially unclear whether the footage was genuine, but as Rockstar begin issuing DMCA takedown notices, it appeared to verify the legitimacy.
CyberLeek's manifesto
Accompanying the first leak were some "commandments" from CyberLeek, including:

CyberLeek's clearest complaint is around digital preorders. It argues that this doesn't benefit customers since the product is a digital download that cannot sell out. GTA 6 will not be released on a physical disc , despite having physical premium editions available.
Jason's road confrontation

The second clip to surface on August 18, titled Random Video 1, showed Jason driving before becoming involved in an altercation with an NPC. It appeared to show that a wide variety of items can be used as weapons, including a wrench.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/GTA6_498cda.png?w=636
The map

Also on August 18, CyberLeek published images purporting to show the map of GTA 6's city, Leonida. GTA mapping communities have extensively researched the images and found that numerous details line up with years of reconstructed information from Rockstar's official marketing materials. The map appears to be made up of a series of in-game screenshots stitched together to show the entire open world.
August 19
Taser video

A third video appeared to show Jason breaking into a facility and using a taser, which would be a new type of weapon for the series if it's in the final build. Many theorized this clip could be from 2025 at the earliest, since it featured a track by Tate McRae that was released in January 2025. It shows Jason could be capable of cloning keys or smashing windows when near vehicles. Jason also seems to collect a hat from the ground and put it on. Vehicle-health and fuel-status bars are shown, too.
After a short cut away, Jason and his friend drink beers on a boat while laughing about using a VPN. Quite apt.
Junkies

A fourth video, titled Junkies, showed Jason kicking a police officer off a motorcycle before stabbing him and driving away on it. It showed a potential wanted level of six stars, something that didn't feature in GTA 5. He then approached a community living underneath a bridge, and as Jason's wanted level increased, a warning appeared on the UI stating that the cops are looking for him and have his description.
It also showed the use of something called Zombix, which will apparently have a weaker effect on your health the more you use it. Bystanders also seem to have the ability to report your crimes.
Stop Killing Games distances itself

Stop Killing Games--an international consumer campaign that hopes publishers will keep purchased games in a playable state after official support ends--has distanced itself from CyberLeek and its tactics. "Using illegal means to make a point is unacceptable to us," it said.
It also urged people to not buy the CyberLeek memecoin. "Do not send these people your money, no matter how much sympathy you may feel for their actions," it explained.
The polls begin

CyberLeek has a memecoin called $CYBERLEEK that appears on all of the watermarked footage. This cryptocurrency's value depends on internet speculation or attention, and CyberLeek said that its token would fund a "secret project." There's been no word so far on what that secret project might be.

As an incentive for people to purchase the token, CyberLeek began running polls for users to decide on the footage they wanted to view next. Whichever poll option had the most tokens purchased against it would be the next released footage. One poll asked users to choose between a car during the day, a car at night, a motorcycle at night, or a plane during the day. The plane won, with 64.4% of the total, leading to the release of the plane video.
August 20
Extended gameplay

This video was the one that really got people talking, as some theorized that the leaker may have access to a playable build of the game. As Jason flew over the city in a plane, it showed the density of the environment, and added new locations. A few radio stations are scrolled through, giving a better idea of what the GTA 6 soundtrack could sound like. However, the most important moment was when the character apparently was directly controlled and used gunfire to spell "Leek" on a nearby wall.
Ending threats

At the same time, CyberLeek threatened to release further material, including potential story and ending spoilers, unless Rockstar and other publishers change their approach to digital games. Some of the videos feature watermarked threats such as, "No physical discs? Then more leeks!"
August 21
Subpoenas

Rockstar parent company Take-Two filed multiple subpoenas requesting that Microsoft and Discord assist it in discovering CyberLeek's identity by providing information on its users. One subpoena filed with the Southern District Court of New York on August 20 showed that it was issuing DMCA takedown notices in order to "obtain the identity of an alleged infringer or infringers," adding that the information would only be used to protect Take-Two's rights.

Take-Two has asked Microsoft and Discord to come up with the internal records before September 4, asking for information including Discord account IDs, registration emails, IP addresses, linked connections, and more.
Seeking advertisers

A new "Contact" tab appeared on the CyberLeek website on August 21 that stated that the individual or group responsible is looking for funds "through community support and strategic partnerships" by selling ad space on its forthcoming leaks. It stressed that this is not a "ransom," though, so that's okay. It'll set those interested back a 400 XMR (Monero) fee, which currently converts to just shy of $165,450. And that's just the fee to contact those responsible.
First hypercar video

The next video to surface is the first hypercar video, which shows Jason driving through the streets in the Truffade Thrax--a car that's currently in GTA Online--performing burnouts and taking part in some pretty irresponsible driving. As far as content goes, it's one of the more uneventful leaked videos, but it does give a good idea of how the city could look at sunset.

news.title: Persona Comes to Beard Papa's With Special 30th Anniversary Collaboration
news.summary: Beard Papa’s is teaming up with Persona to celebrate the RPG series’ 30th anniversary with some special cream

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/persona4-creampuffs-blogroll-1787611272077.jpg
Beard Papa’s is teaming up with Persona to celebrate the RPG series’ 30th anniversary with some special cream puffs.

Beard Papa’s is a Japanese dessert chain with locations sprinkled across the US. It’s best known for its primary offering, cream puffs, which come in a variety of different flavors and combinations for customers to choose from.
Starting September 4, participating Beard Papa’s locations within the United States will transform their interiors and offer up several new flavors of cream puffs in collaboration with Persona.

These storefronts will feature Persona-themed digital menu boards, bakery case graphics, posters, television displays, and more, transforming them into a real-life Persona menu screen. And for mega-fans, the Beard Papa’s locations in Little Tokyo and Cerritos will include large-format anniversary murals specifically designed for photo opportunities.

Limited-time cream puff flavors are also on offer: Original Cream Puff, Matcha Cream Puff, Ube S'mores Cream Puff, Cookies & Cream Cream Puff, and the Double Berry Cream Puff, each inspired by specific games in the Persona series.

Four and six-pack gift sets are also available for purchase. The four-pack set comes with four featured cream puffs, a Persona chibi sticker sheet, and an in-game code card for Persona 5: The Phantom X. The six-pack set comes with six cream puffs, a blind-packed acrylic standee featuring one of eight designs, and an in-game code card for Persona 5: The Phantom X.

Of course, it wouldn’t be a collab if there wasn’t merchandise involved; you can also snag a ceramic mug, a T-shirt, zip hoodie, and eco tote bag as part of the Persona x Beard Papa’s partnership on the official Beard Papa’s website .

This collaboration lasts from September 4 to October 4, just in time to herald the next big developments for the Persona series. Persona 4 Revival, a full remake of Persona 4 Golden, is set to release in February 2027 , and Atlus is hard at work on the next entry in the franchise, Persona 6.

It’s a big time for Persona; a live-action adaptation is in the works at Netflix, with Christopher Monfette attached as writer, showrunner, and executive producer. 21 Laps' Shawn Levy and Robert Atwood are also attached to executive produce, alongside Sega’s Toru Nakahara.

Beyond that, Kazuhisa Wada, producer for Atlus' P-Studio, recently remarked that he believes the studio will “have to” do remakes of the first and second games in the Persona series, giving fans even more to look forward to as the days tick down to Persona 4 Revival’s release.

news.title: A game dev spent 40 days in the wilderness to make this new Steam survival game
news.summary: Can you guide a lone survivor to safety in FMV survival game Wordless Forest?

content.v: I've always wondered how I'd fare in a survival situation. Lost in the woods, with no food or water, how long would I last? Would I make good choices? Could I find my way back to safety?

The answers to those questions are almost certainly "Not long, no, and definitely not," and hopefully I'll never have to actually find out. In the meantime, I try to live out my survival fantasies through films and games, and Wordless Forest, which launched on Steam today, is sorta both.

Wordless Forest is an FMV survival game solo developer Dogus Cagrici shot while hiking in the "dense forests and wilderness of four different cities across Turkey for 40 days ." It's completely dialogue-free (hence the title) as the character Cagrici plays finds himself alone in the wilds, trying to find his way to safety and put his scrambled memories back together after a head injury.

As the survivor attempts to make his way to a distant firewatch tower, you'll have to make choices for him. There's some food at an abandoned campsite that may be unsafe to eat: should you risk it? A dark cave might present some shelter but also be hiding danger: should you check it out? And maybe most importantly, your dog is missing: should you follow its footprints deeper into the wilderness, or focus on getting yourself to safety? The choices are presented on-screen as an either/or option, and clicking one will advance the story in that direction.

I see the early reviews on Steam are mixed, and I'm not that surprised. I played through Wordless Forest this morning, and it's not the most interactive adventure, really: over about 45 minutes of my runthrough there weren't a huge amount of choices to make, and I can imagine some players might find more of a short interactive movie than a game.

But despite the short running time and lean interactivity, I still found it pretty compelling. It's well-filmed, especially considering Cagrici did seemingly everything himself, including clambering up cliffs, crawling into caves, and even eating raw fish. You think a lot of survival game devs would subject themselves to that?

Most of all, I appreciate stories that can be told with minimal dialogue, especially survival stories. All Is Lost, the Robert Redford film about a man trying to survive at sea after his boat is damaged, is done with nearly no dialogue, and the best parts of Cast Away are done in near-silence, too.

I like that approach to storytelling. It's the extreme of the "show, don't tell" rule, and Wordless Forest does a good job pulling it off. You'll find it here on Steam , where it's 10% off for the next two weeks.

news.title: My FOMO over The Duskbloods not coming to PC evaporated once I actually played it
news.summary: The vampire PvPvE game is a confusing mess that isn't going to be for everyone.

content.v: As a big Elden Ring person with an additional 600 hours in Nightreign, the FOMO of FromSoftware's next multiplayer experiment, The Duskbloods, being a Switch 2 exclusive was hitting me hard. That is, until I actually played it: I spent the majority of the closed network test held over the weekend confused about what the hell was going on, and even when I finally learned, I wasn't particularly impressed.

To be fair, the network test wasn't built to make a great first impression. It was limited to one map, six playable characters, no build customization, solo queue only, and seemed to only have a portion of its intro tutorial. I also experienced borderline unplayable input lag from the Switch 2's docked and handheld modes, which meant I was fighting the basic controls for longer than I'd like.

Assuming the final game will have all of that fixed and more, I might end up liking The Duskbloods in the end. Elden Ring Nightreign didn't click for me for close to 20 hours, and when it did, I dug it so much I spent the first half of this year playing it daily, even climbing to the highest level of its ranked mode. The Duskbloods might reveal itself to be a masterfully created vampire multiplayer game, but as it stands right now I think it's an aimless mess of intriguing systems that don't cohere into anything worth PC gamers buying a $500 ( for now ) console for.

What does impress me is how bizarre The Duskbloods is as a videogame in 2026. At times it felt like playing a PlayStation 2 game I brought home from Blockbuster with an offbeat multiplayer mode someone cooked up with before battle royales and hero shooters codified a framework for how it's done. Tutorial popups will tell you things like, "To obtain Virtue visit Sites of Ritual to pledge yourself on the Eve of the Third Moon before the final Bestowal." That's the kind of needlessly opaque but deliciously evocative language I love to see in a FromSoft game, but it also does absolutely nothing to prepare you for what it's like to actually play it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WHqWwLVsVnuMwYnGAL7Yof.png

The simplest way I can describe The Duskbloods is by using MOBA words. It's a game about killing creeps to level up and collect Virtue points as you prepare for the final PvP team fight (or free-for-all in solos) at the end of every match. Enemy players are there to gank you or be ganked by you as you race to become the strongest combatant in the lobby. Otherwise, collecting Virtue is your entire goal from the moment you and seven other players drop into the map and the first round begins. The rest of the game's systems are there to disrupt you on your quest to farm as much Virtue as possible so you don't get kicked, or culled, from the match early.

Even though I expected the PvP aspect of The Duskbloods to be the worst part as someone who avoids it in FromSoft's other games, it's actually so meaningless for the majority of a match that I almost wish there was more reason to hunt down players, but it's huge risk with little reward. Dying to other players doesn't do anything but set you back on your Virtue farm. It's more lucrative to play it like you're speedrunning a normal Souls game with opportunities to PvP every now and then if you want.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/CHuor6yXaDLxCFEtBcAZ5g.png

On paper, the Nightreign player in me should eat that up. This is a game where everyone can triple jump and air dash like it's nothing. Over the course of my matches, however, I never fought anything that required more than your usual attack-and-dodge approach. Most monsters die in a few hits and the bosses ping-pong between players while everyone spams attacks into them until they die. I can't tell which ones, if any, are supposed to be fodder like in a MOBA or challenging foes that reward you for memorizing their moves. At times, the hardest fight was with my eyelids, as I farmed the same mincemeat enemies over and over again. The routine is only occasionally broken by another player engaging a boss that lets everyone join under a temporary truce to help fight it. My hope is that the final game has more of these moments that rely on having a handful of players participating.

The Duskbloods desperately needs more reasons to care about its cast of certified freaks and their unique skills that aren't purely PvP-focused. I love that I can turn it into a third-person shooter as Sniper Layla and press a button to make a gatling gun burst out of her chest, but standing still as you one-shot weak enemies gets stale real quick. Trang Lanh's invisibility skill is largely useless against monsters who all have big attacks that'll hit you anyway, which just reduces her into a weaker melee character. Even everyone's favorite walking submarine, Zork, plays like your typical heavy-armored Souls character until other players show up and you actually have a reason to rocket yourself into them (AKA "Zorking it" ).
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/D42hoyQHGmdXLZQXYfwzJg.png

Recruiting enemies as allies by yelling at them until they surrender is also great, as are the unique Kin you can have by your side. I found a shirtless man named Baritone who stood by me and sang to give me a defense buff and a small snake girl inexplicably named "Gargoyle" who healed me. You can level these weirdos up and have them tank tougher monsters for you, which ends up being pretty important as you get deeper into a match. The Kin are Elden Ring's Spirit Ash summons if they were smarter and permanent—a really fun idea that I hope future character kits can build around. Unfortunately, the Kin feel ill-equipped for the speed of PvP fights, even sometimes sabotaging you by ruining a sneaky ambush by sprinting straight into battle.

Even with its problems, I am fascinated by FromSoft's irresistible premise: a bunch of vampires from different eras and factions fighting on the eve of an apocalypse to give themselves up to a giant moon dripping with blood. I would like to know why there is a steampunk airship in the sky and why one of the bosses looks like Bloodborne's Lady Maria riding on a headless horse. There are echoes of other FromSoft games imbued into the world, but so far it's only enough for director Hidetaka Miyazaki to remind us that better games exist.

I used to be a believer that The Duskbloods would eventually make its way to the PC, but recent comments from Miyazaki seem to imply Nintendo's involvement was so pivotal to the project that I wouldn't be surprised if the exclusivity is indefinite. We've got another Bloodborne on our hands, apparently.

So with us computer-havers being denied the chance to play The Duskbloods with better framerates and no paid subscription, maybe we're not missing much. Its best ideas fall flat in a game that is mostly about farming enemies like you're on a quest in an MMO from 10 years ago. Nothing about it grabbed me and I'm worried it might end up being the first FromSoft game that I simply skip.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6offQUY4CXebir2TC27dMd.jpg

news.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Devs Vow to Update Captain Price After Botched Haircut Goes Viral
news.summary: Publisher Activision and developer Infinity Ward have promised to update Captain Price's hair in Call of Duty:

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-captain-price-hair-1787605087848.png
Publisher Activision and developer Infinity Ward have promised to update Captain Price's hair in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 after images of his botched haircut went viral.

As last weekend's closed beta dredged up conversations revolving around its time-to-kill (TTK) speeds and problematic spawn placements, other fans aimed at Captain Price and his barber. It's mostly thanks to a few images that have circulated across social media, with fans pointing out that, maybe, Modern Warfare 4's version of the classic character should invest in some hair gel.

He looks…unwell, at least when compared to past versions of Captain Price. Whether he's chasing down Vladimir Makarov or walking you through a training course, Price is known to have a full head of hair and a beard that could make even Ghost blush. The one from Modern Warfare 4, however, has neither of those things, and according to many, he hardly looks like the Task Force 141 leader fans have come to know. Activision and Infinity Ward say that's not their intention, but there's also a good reason why only some Call of Duty fans are encountering this choppy imposter.
bro.... https://t.co/JxOTxMTny3 pic.twitter.com/WQEHOTgdEU
that ain't captain Price that's lieutenant Cost https://t.co/gtAFT18NhF
That ain’t price that’s amount

While the Captain Price making the rounds online does appear to be real, he'll only look this way in Modern Warfare 4 if users tune their devices to the lowest possible settings. Some had expected this to be the case, as reports of the botched haircut seemed to mostly be few and far between.

Still, the developers and Activision and Infinity Ward are going to do their best to give the Call of Duty fan-favorite Operator the head of hair he deserves. The studio community teams X/Twitter account replied to a few of the more popular posts, promising it would be addressed "in a future update."
"Captain Price's hair does not appear correctly when viewing his character model at the lowest level of detail," a tab in the "Known Issues" column from the Modern Warfare 4 Trello says.

Hello! We're aware of an issue with Price's hair not appearing correctly when viewed at the lowest level of detail. The team will be addressing it in a future update. Ultimately this will not be an issue if players meet our recommended specs. Details: https://t.co/uozRRLS3W5
What in the 1050 TI is this? Whoever took that screenshot got the game at ultra low, ultra performance, 11% resolution. pic.twitter.com/Pq3A5BdzFt

What exactly that update entails remains to be seen, but it's far from the only thing on the team's list. Also noted in the Known Issues category are dropped framerates when cooking lethal weapons, hitches for PC players during their first multiplayer matches, a stuck loadout screen bug, and more. TTK is another issue the team is looking into , as are those spawns.

So, if you find yourself dissatisfied with the Modern Warfare 4 beta, you might want to take another crack at it when the open beta launches this weekend . You can learn more about everything it comes with, including its single-player mission, here .

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has a release date of October 23, 2026, for PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X | S. For more, you can read about how it will allow players to remove masks for some of its Operators . You can also check out IGN's interview with the team to learn about Infinity Ward's approach to matchmaking, the beta, and more.
Image credit: X user @Runhob.

news.title: Canceled Iron Man Game Footage From Just Cause and Mad Max Developer Leaks Online
news.summary: Alleged footage from Avalanche Studios' canceled Iron Man game has surfaced online.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2022/09/20/iron-man-ea-motive-1663686372718.jpg
Alleged footage from Avalanche Studios' canceled Iron Man game has surfaced online.

In the early 2010s, Just Cause and Mad Max developer Avalanche Studios was working on an Iron Man game . The project was never officially announced to the public, but Avalanche Studios co-founder Christofer Sundberg confirmed its development and cancellation during an interview in 2022. Now, gameplay for that title has popped up online via Reddit , reportedly sourced through a PS3 developer kit.

The gameplay is extremely unfinished, but it shows Iron Man flying around in a large environment, fighting jets and attacking various facilities. One of the more in-depth videos appears to be an unfinished E3 demo which shows Iron Man in hand-to-hand combat with soldiers, using a heavy, Arkham-esque style of combat. Of course, he also boasts his repulsors, missiles, and other gadgets to help take down all of his targets.

One of the more standout features is that the environments would've been at least semi-destructible. Iron Man can throw foes through walls, slice them apart in order to make shortcuts for himself, and tear up buildings around him. Beyond that, the build isn't far along enough to really distinguish itself much from SEGA's MCU Iron Man games. It certainly shows promise, though. Given how fun the studio's Mad Max game is and the sandbox gameplay of the Just Cause series, Avalanche probably would've made a killer Iron Man game.

There is still some hope, however. EA Motive is currently developing a new Iron Man game , though details on the project are extremely scarce. The project entered development in 2022, but there haven't been any updates since then. EA was also working on a Black Panther game, which was canceled last year . However, Iron Man has remained in development, despite fears that it will suffer the same fate. Given it has been four years since the announcement, hopefully we are close to hearing some news on the title.
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

news.title: Latest GTA 6 leak confirms full dong
news.summary: It's perfectly natural.

content.v: I'll be the first to admit that I have my reservations about enigmatic cryptopeddler / self-appointed anticorporate folk hero / world's most humdrum most wanted suspect Cyberleek. But I can't say their repeated leaks haven't done us all the service of answering our most burning GTA 6 questions—questions like, "If I play GTA 6, how often should I expect to confront someone who's just straight up hanging hog?"
Thanks to Cyberleek's latest illicit gameplay drop, the answer for that particular question is: Quite often, if you're frequenting one particular spot in the state of Leonida.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8mUxgWFStriutEKpPtdB2k.jpg

If you're not picking up what I'm putting down, the title of the most recent GTA 6 leak should help you with that sticky wicket: It's called "nudist_town.mp4," and it consists of the player surveying the uncensored denizens of an in-game nudist retreat—some of whom are, justifiably, unenthusiastic about being creeped on from mere feet away by a dude in work jeans with a pair of binoculars.

And when I say uncensored, I mean uncensored. We won't share the leaked video here for legal reasons, but if you seek it out yourself—it's not hard to find—you should expect to see the full spectrum of human bits and bodies matching every description except "clothed."

It's not exactly a Hot Coffee scenario, however. There's some close-proximity twerking and gyrating happening, but aside from the bared genitalia, there's really not much explicit activity going on as GTA 6 protagonist Jason takes in the scenery. There's just… a bunch of naked people standing around. I guess nudists do just as much aimless loitering as the rest of us.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Ee4X5pRorHpBkdRRgbxwmF.jpg

Perhaps there's a lesson there. But if there is, Cyberleek doesn't seem very receptive: The video ends after they start shooting everyone because one of the nudists got mad at them for creeping too hard. Or at least, they tried to shoot everyone, and in the process dumped most of a magazine into some deck chairs. It seems Cyberleek shoots as well as they drive.

As with their previous GTA 6 leaks, nudist_town.mp4 features the expected QR code directing viewers to the cybercurrency scheme animating this whole operation. But it sounds like Cyberleek has graduated to the "making demands" stage of internet notoriety: The text watermark plastered on-screen throughout the footage says "to show support at least 10 gamers need to show up dressed as leeks in front of Take-Two / Rockstar offices holding game discs during working hours."

We'll see how that goes, I guess. Considering a YouTuber was arrested mere months ago for trespassing on the Rockstar North office premises, my expert advice would be to be normal instead. But hey, in the meantime, full dong confirmed.
